body.text: The title of →Papus’s work Martinésisme, Willermosisme, Martinisme et Franc-Maçonnerie (Martinesism, Willermozism, Martinism, and Freemasonry, 1899) encompasses fairly exactly what modern historiography understands under the name of “Martinism”, at least for the period of its origins and early developments (18th-beginning of the 19th century). The expression “Second Martinism” applies to the history of the Martinist Order as “re-awakened”, as Papus put it – though in fact he founded it – in 1887 [→Martinism: Second Period]. The term “Martinism” refers in part to →Louis-Claude de Saint-Martin, but much more to →Martines de Pasqually, the master in matters of thought, action, prayer, and ritual of all those who constitute the type of esotericism thus named. This company, apparently heterogeneous but basically united, is sufficiently profiled to distinguish it from the other currents of thought of the 18th century, even when those currents take on initiatic forms (namely masonic ones), and to arouse contrasting reactions, now as then.
body.zh: →帕普斯（Papus）的著作《马丁内斯主义、维勒莫兹主义、马丁主义与共济会》（Martinésisme, Willermosisme, Martinisme et Franc-Maçonnerie，1899）这一标题，相当准确地涵盖了现代史学在“马丁主义”名下所理解的内容，至少就其起源与早期发展（18世纪至19世纪初）而言是如此。“第二马丁主义”一语，则用以指称马丁主义修会（Ordre Martiniste）的历史，如帕普斯所言，该会于1887年“重新苏醒”——尽管事实上正是他创立了该会［→马丁主义：第二时期］。“马丁主义”一词部分指向→路易-克洛德·德·圣马丁（Louis-Claude de Saint-Martin），但更多指向→马丁内斯·德·帕斯夸利（Martines de Pasqually）——在思想、行动、祈祷与仪式诸事上，他是所有构成这一名目下秘传类型之人的导师。这一群体表面上杂糅，实则归于一体；其轮廓足够分明，足以与18世纪其他思想潮流相区别——即便那些潮流也采取了入门形式（即共济会的入门形式）——并且足以激起彼此对立的反应，今昔皆然。

body.text: 1 . The Doctrine In the beginning was Martines de Pasqually, and above all his doctrine: this is what defines “Martinism”. This doctrine is a gnosis, i.e, a “science” in the esoteric sense of the word, on which all Martines’ disciples (Saint-Martin, → Willermoz, →de Maistre, among others) are agreed. According to this sense, science is not predicated on the acquisition of learning or knowledge (though that aspect is far from absent), but much more on the transformation of the inner being of the person who devotes himself to it. It is conceived as spiritually active and operative: a transformative science which applies less to objects than to the subject.
body.zh: 1. 教义　在起初，是马丁内斯·德·帕斯夸利，而首先是他所提出的教义：正是这一点界定着“马丁主义”。这一教义是一种诺斯（gnosis），即“科学”一词在秘传意义上的那种“科学”，马丁内斯的所有弟子（圣马丁、→维勒莫兹、→迈斯特等人）对此皆表同意。按此意义，科学并不建立在学问或知识的获取之上（尽管这一方面远非缺席），而更多建立在献身于此道者内在存在的转化之上。它被设想为在灵性上能动的、有实效的：一门转化性的科学，与其说作用于客体，不如说作用于主体。

body.text: This doctrine is all-encompassing. It is a “hierohistory”, a sacred History; a history of man and the universe in their mutual relationships and in their relationship to God; a history which is not merely descriptive but dynamic, made of actions and reactions (or “counter-actions” as Martines called them) on the part of both man and God. This metahistory is not restricted to reportage, to drawing up a Natural Table of the Relationships between God, Man, and the Universe – to cite the title of a well-known work of Saint-Martin – and of their evolution; it is all aimed at the modification of these relationships and, briefly, at their restoration. For these relationships have become degraded, and everything depends on re-establishing them in their original integrity. The history in question, typical of sacred histories, thus consists of acts of rebellion of man against God, and of God’s interventions for the punishment of man, followed by his reconciliation – his punishment being intended to achieve his reconciliation.
body.zh: 这一教义涵盖一切。它是一种“圣史”（hierohistory），一部神圣的历史；一部关于人与宇宙在其相互关系之中、并在其与上帝的关系之中的历史；这部历史不只是描述性的，而是动态的，由人与上帝双方的行动与反作用（或如马丁内斯所称的“反行动”，counter-actions）构成。这种元历史并不局限于记述，不局限于绘制一幅上帝、人与宇宙之关系的“自然图表”——借用圣马丁一部名作的标题——并记述其演化；它的一切都旨在改变这些关系，简言之，旨在恢复这些关系。因为这些关系已经败坏，而一切都取决于将它们重新建立于原初的完整状态之中。如此，这一历史——神圣历史之典型——便由人反抗上帝的行动、上帝为惩罚人而施行的干预，以及随后人与上帝的和解所构成——惩罚乃是为了达成和解。

body.text: Martines’ doctine, and the practice that goes with it, thus comprise: 1) a cosmology that is also a cosmogony, opening up onto a cosmosophy; 2) an anthropology that is an anthropogenesis and also an anthroposophy; 3) a theology that is a theosophy; 4) an angelology that is an “angeloduly”: a cult of, and with, the angels, hence a liturgy. All these are placed under the sign of Wisdom, or as Saint-Martin would later call it, Sophia.
body.zh: 因此，马丁内斯的教义及与之相伴的实践包括：1）一种宇宙论，它同时是一种宇宙生成论，并通向一种宇宙智慧论（cosmosophy）；2）一种人类学，它同时是人类生成论，也是一种人智论（anthroposophy）；3）一种神学，它即是神智学；4）一种天使论，它同时是一种“天使崇敬”（angeloduly）：对天使的崇拜，以及偕同天使的崇拜，因而是一种礼仪。所有这一切都被置于智慧的标志之下，或如圣马丁后来所称的索菲亚（Sophia）。

body.text: At the origin alike of time and of the world there was the Fall, which Martines calls “prevarication” – a term commonly used in the French spiritual school of the classic age. It was a double event: a fall or prevarication first of the angels, then of man. But there was a history before history, a time before time. In that pre-historic, pre-temporal time, the Eternal (a term that underlines the Creator God’s sovereign exemption from all temporal determination) emanates “spirits” in the bosom of what Martines calls the “divine immensity”. Their number is infinite, and this “infinity” is not static but dynamic: ‘the multitude of the inhabitants of the divine immensity increases and will increase ceaselessly and infinitely, without ever reaching a limit’, since the divine fecundity is uninterrupted: God never ceases to create.
body.zh: 时间与世界的开端，同样是堕落，马丁内斯称之为“僭越”（prévarication）——这是古典时代法国灵修学派常用的一个词。这是一个双重事件：先是天使的堕落或僭越，然后是人的堕落或僭越。但在历史之前还有一段历史，在时间之前还有一个时间。在那个前历史的、前时间的时代，永恒者（这一称谓强调造物主上帝对所有时间性规定的至高豁免）在马丁内斯所称的“神圣无限”（divine immensity）之中流溢出“诸灵”。它们的数目无穷，而这种“无限”不是静态的而是动态的：“神圣无限之居民的众多，正不断增长，并将无休无止、无穷无尽地增长，永不到达极限”，因为神圣的丰产从未间断：上帝从不停止创造。

body.text: To be exact, the term “create” is inappropriate here, for Martines reserves it for the production of material and temporal forms, whereas for the divine productions on the spiritual plane he uses the words “emanate” and “emanation”. The distinction is important, for it leads one to envisage the “divine essence” under two different aspects. The term “essence” is used here following Martines’ best exegete, Robert Amadou, not in the philosophical sense and even less in the theological sense, but rather in the chemical or alchemical sense of “species” or of “active nature”. From this double point of view, this divine essence is “triple” relative to creation, and “quatriple” relative to emanation, the “quatriple” being moreover primary in relation to the triple. A complex numerology and arithmosophy [→Number Symbolism] derive from this, preserved by all Martines’ disciples. They are found, for example, in the degrees of the Régime Ecossais Rectifié as instituted by Jean-Baptiste Willermoz.
body.zh: 确切地说，“创造”一词在此并不恰当，因为马丁内斯把它留给了物质性与时间性形式的产生，而就灵性层面上神圣的产生而言，他用的是“流溢”与“流溢物”这两个词。这一区分十分重要，因为它引导人们从两个不同的方面来设想“神圣本质”。这里依照马丁内斯最好的注释者罗贝尔·阿马杜（Robert Amadou）的用法，“本质”一词不是在哲学意义上使用，更不是在神学意义上使用，而是在化学或炼金术意义上指“种”（species）或“能动的自然”。从这一双重视角看，这一神圣本质相对于创造而言是“三重”的，相对于流溢而言是“四重的”（quatriple），而“四重”相对“三重”又更具原初性。由此衍生出一套复杂的数字学与数论智慧（arithmosophy）［→数字象征］，为马丁内斯的所有弟子所保存。例如，在让-巴蒂斯特·维勒莫兹（Jean-Baptiste Willermoz）所创立的苏格兰修正礼制（Régime Ecossais Rectifié）的诸等级中，即可见到它们。

body.text: It is important to note that the terms “emanate” and “emanation” have nothing to do with “emanationism”, a form of pantheism found in several variants of →Gnosticism. The classic language to which Martines, for all his awkwardness and idiosyncracy of expression, pays tribute, implies nothing of the sort. E.g. Furetière in his Dictionnaire of 1690 defines emanation as “dependance on a cause, on a superior power”, giving as an example: “The rational soul is an emanation of Divinity”.
body.zh: 应当注意，“流溢”与“流溢物”二词与“流溢论”（emanationism）毫无关系，后者是→诺斯替主义若干变体中可见的一种泛神论形态。马丁内斯尽管表达笨拙而带有个人癖性，却仍归属于那种古典语言，而那种语言并不含有任何此类意味。例如，菲雷蒂埃（Furetière）在其1690年的《词典》中把流溢定义为“对某一原因、某一更高力量的依赖”，并举例如下：“理性灵魂是神性的流溢”。

body.text: Martines derives an important significance from this “emanation” in respect to the essence of the “spirits” that are thus perpetually emanated. They certainly do not belong to the divine essence, because they emanate from it; but still they participate in it, because, as Martines states, ‘they have in themselves a part of the divine domination’. The totality of these spirits constitute the “divine immensity”, which is not God. Thus, ‘the fullness of divinity, but not the Deity, [belongs] to the emanated spirits’ (Amadou). This similarity of essence, which is not identity, recurs in the Régime Ecossais Rectifié under the dynamically initiatic theme of the “image and resemblance”, Martinesian by origin but accommodated to Christianity, in whose tradition it also figures. Martines also calls the “divine immensity” the “divine court”. Like every court, it is hierarchical: the spirits are differentiated in “classes” or “circles” which are ‘distinguished from one another by their virtues, their powers, and their names . . . according to their faculties of divine spiritual operations’. Moreover, although Martines states that ‘this famous divine immensity [is] incomprehensible not only to mortals but to every emanated spirit; this knowledge belongs to the Creator alone’, he himself has given us his observations about the angelic hierarchies such as he has contemplated them.
body.zh: 马丁内斯从这种“流溢”中，就如此永恒流溢而出的“诸灵”之本质，引出了重要的意义。它们当然不属于神圣本质，因为它们由之流溢而出；但它们仍然分有它，因为正如马丁内斯所说，“它们自身之中有一部分神圣的统治权”。这些灵的总体构成“神圣无限”，而神圣无限并不是上帝。因此，“属于流溢诸灵的，是神性的充满，而非神格本身”（阿马杜）。这种本质上的相似而非同一，在苏格兰修正礼制中，以“肖像与相似”这一具有动态入门意味的主题再次出现——这一主题源于马丁内斯，却被调适于基督教，而基督教传统中本也有此说。马丁内斯还把“神圣无限”称为“神圣宫廷”。如同一切宫廷，它是分等级的：诸灵被区分为若干“等级”或“圈层”，它们“依其神圣灵性运作的才能，凭其德能、权能与名号而彼此区别”。此外，尽管马丁内斯声称“这一著名的神圣无限，不仅对凡人，而且对一切流溢之灵都是不可理解的；此种知识惟属于造物主”，他本人却向我们提供了他就其所观照的天使品阶所作的观察。

body.text: According to a summary by Willermoz, these circles are four in number: ‘10. Circle of superior denary spirits: the agents and special ministers of the universal denary power of the Father, creator of all things. 8. Circle of major octonary spirits: immediate agents and ministers of the Word of God, which is the being of double quaternary power. 7. Circle of inferior septenary spirits: direct agents and ministers of the divine operative Action of divine quaternary power and operating the triple creative essence. 3. Circle of minor ternary spirits: agents of manifestation of the divine quatriple essence’.
body.zh: 据维勒莫兹的一份概述，这些圈层共有四个：“10. 上等十重灵之圈：万物之造物主——圣父——之普遍十重权能的代理者与专门执事。8. 大八重灵之圈：上帝之圣言的直接代理者与执事，此圣言即具有双重四重权能的存在者。7. 下等七重灵之圈：具有神圣四重权能、并运作三重创造本质的神圣运作行动的直接代理者与执事。3. 小三重灵之圈：神圣四重本质之显化的代理者”。

body.text: Thus the hierarchy of spirits is a hierarchy of functions, which refer to the three Persons of the Holy Trinity. All the same, Martines explicitly rejects the hypostatic distinction (i.e., that of the Three Hypostases or divine Persons) on which Christian theology has rested since the dogmatic formulations of the Council of Nicaea (325). In technical terms, he was what is called a “Unitarian”, or to be absolutely strict, a “modalist”. For him, the distinction between the “three Persons of God” is more symbolic than real, referring to ‘three divine faculties which are Thought, Will, and Action, or in another sense . . . the Intention, the Word, and the Operation’. These three faculties are typified by the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, and also symbolized by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For this reason, these three personages are constantly present in the prayers and degrees of the Order of →Elus Coëns.
body.zh: 因此，诸灵的品阶是一种职能的品阶，而这些职能指向圣三一的三个位格。然而，马丁内斯明确拒斥位格性的区分（即三个位格或神圣位格之别），而自尼西亚公会议（325）的教义表述以来，基督教神学一直以此为基础。用专门的术语说，他属于所谓的“一位论者”（Unitarian），或者严格说来，属于“形态论者”（modalist）。在他看来，“上帝的三个位格”之间的区分与其说是实在的，不如说是象征性的，所指的乃是“三种神圣能力，即思想、意志与行动，或者换一种说法……意图、言语与运作”。这三种能力以圣父、圣子、圣灵为代表，也以亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各为象征。正因如此，这三个人物不断出现在→选民科恩会的祈祷文与等级礼仪之中。

body.text: This trinitarian theology, which was not so much heterodox as archaistic, or as Amadou says, “pre-Nicaean”, was hardly acceptable to Martines’ disciples, all Christians in faith and practice. The paradox was that Martines insisted, as a condition of admission into his Order, on membership of a church, namely the Roman Catholic Church, of which he himself really did not accept one of the two fundamental dogmas, that of the Holy Trinity. The other one was that of the double nature of Christ, which on the contrary he fully embraced. Thus one very soon sees his disciples returning, for example in the Leçons de Lyon (Lessons of Lyon, 1774-1776), to a dogmatically orthodox trinitarian theology.
body.zh: 这一三位一体神学与其说是异端的，不如说是复古的，或者如阿马杜所言，是“前尼西亚的”；它对马丁内斯的弟子们来说几乎无法接受，因为他们在信仰与实践上都是基督徒。矛盾在于，马丁内斯坚持把加入某个教会——即罗马天主教会——作为入会的条件，而他本人在两个基本教义中恰恰并不真正接受其中之一，即圣三一教义。另一条则是基督二性论，对此他反倒完全接受。因此，人们很快就看到他的弟子们——例如在《里昂课程》（Leçons de Lyon，1774—1776）中——回归到教义上正统的三位一体神学。

body.text: The divine immensity, although in dynamic expansion, was perfect, hence sufficient unto itself. But then a first accident occurred, with the prevarication of perverse spirits who, wanting to equal the Eternal, strove to become first causes as He was, instead of the secondary causes that they were. They wanted to “operate” like Him, i.e., to emanate. Needless to say, this failed, unleashing a cosmic catastrophe in the literal sense of the word. In fact, the Eternal created, or rather ordered the minor spirits who had remained loyal to create, the temporal material universe (this being no longer a matter of emanation but rather of creation), so as to ‘contain and subject the evil spirits in a state of privation’ in it; in other words, to imprison the “prevaricating spirits” therein. Here we find the recurrence of an idea common to various forms of →Gnosticism, namely that matter is connoted as evil. Yet there is an important difference, in that for Martines matter is not evil in itself; on the contrary, it is intended to contain evil and prevent it from contaminating everything. Moreover, since evil has not a positive but a negative definition, and consequently has no constituent reality, matter also has none. Matter, just like evil, is destined to disappear and disintegrate. Martines keeps repeating that matter is null and void, that it is only appearance, and that there is no true reality but spiritual reality. This is another legacy of Martinesian doctrine to the Régime Écossais Rectifié, found particularly in the Master’s degree.
body.zh: 神圣无限虽然在动态地扩张，却是完美的，因而自足。但随后发生了第一次意外，即那些邪恶之灵的僭越：它们想要与永恒者平等，竭力要像他那样成为第一因，而不满足于自己本是第二因。它们想“运作”，即流溢。无须说，这失败了，引发了一场字面意义上的宇宙灾变。事实上，永恒者创造了——或者更确切地说，命令那些仍保持忠诚的小灵去创造——时间性的物质宇宙（此时已不再是流溢，而是创造），以便在其中“将邪恶之灵容纳并制服于匮乏状态之中”；换言之，把“僭越之灵”囚禁于其中。在此我们见到某种为→诺斯替主义各种形态所共有的观念的再现，即物质被赋予了恶的意涵。然而有一个重要的差别：对马丁内斯来说，物质本身并非恶的；恰恰相反，物质旨在容纳恶，阻止恶污染一切。此外，既然恶只有否定性的定义而没有肯定性的定义，因而没有构成性的实在，那么物质也同样没有。物质与恶一样，注定要消失、解体。马丁内斯不断重复：物质是虚无，只是表象，除了灵性的实在，并无真正的实在。这是马丁内斯教义留给苏格兰修正礼制的又一份遗产，尤其见于师傅等级（Master’s degree）之中。

body.text: Matter is created by the operations of the minor ternary spirits. This is done by setting in motion a whole series of ternaries or triads that have issued by simultaneous or successive combinations from the first ternary, that of the “spirituous essences” (“spirituous” in the chemical or alchemical sense, not to be confused with “spiritual”). These essences themselves have ‘stemmed from the divine imagination’, whereas spiritual beings, on the contrary – and the difference is essential – pre-exist in God (see above; there is a similarity here with Origen’s idea of the pre-existence of souls in God). These primitive “spirituous essences”, called Salt, Sulfur, and Mercury as in the alchemical treatises, produce through their mixtures the three elements of Water, Fire, and Earth, then, also by mixture, the three corporeal principles known as “aquatic”, “igneous”, and “solid”. Consequently Martines assigns symbolically a “triangular form” to the earth, explaining that it ‘has only three noteworthy horizons: north, south, and west’. The lodges of the Régime Ecossais Rectifié were also heirs to this.
body.zh: 物质是由小三重灵的运作所创造的。其方式是启动一整个系列的三重组合（ternaries），它们由最初的三重组合——即“精气本质”（spirituous essences，“精气”取其化学或炼金术意义，不可与“灵性的”相混淆）——通过同时或相继的组合而产生。这些本质本身“源于神圣的想象”，而灵性存在着则相反——这一差别至关重要——预先存在于上帝之中（见上文；此处与奥利金关于灵魂预先存在于上帝之中的观念有相似之处）。这些原初的“精气本质”，如炼金术论著中那样被称为盐、硫与汞，通过其混合产生水、火、土三种元素，然后又通过混合产生被称为“水性的”、“火性的”与“固体的”三种形体本原。因此，马丁内斯象征性地赋予大地一种“三角形”，并解释说大地“只有三个值得注意的方位：北、南与西”。苏格兰修正礼制的会所也继承了这一点。

body.text: The cosmic catastrophe did not fail to have its effect on the “divine court”. The minor ternary spirits were obliged to leave it, having been delegated by the Eternal first to the creation, then to the conservation (see below) of the temporal material universe. And while at the summit of the angelic hierarchy ‘the divine denary spirits have never left the place they occupy in the divine immensity’, other spirits in their turn were ‘subjected to the temporal, although they were not at all subject to time’ by their own nature: they too are, in effect, delegated outside this immensity in order to ‘perform . . . temporal spiritual actions’, or in other words to ‘act and operate in the supercelestial, the celestial, and the terrestrial’ – the three divisions of the created universe (see below) – because they are ‘destined to accomplish the temporal manifestation of the Creator’s justice and glory’. This delegation outside the divine immensity is called by Martines “emancipation”, which should in no way be confused with “emanation”. There was, is, and will always be emanation in eternity, or at least in sempiternity. But emancipation has only occurred within time, and that only for reasons of circumstance. Thus all the ternary spirits have been emancipated in order to attend to the material things of the universe, as well as a ‘sufficient number’ of septenary spirits, to ‘perform temporal spiritual actions in the supercelestial’; and some of them, to this end, have been ‘endowed with a denary power’, because the denary spirits have remained in their place.
body.zh: 这场宇宙灾变不可能不在“神圣宫廷”中产生后果。小三重灵不得不离开那里，因为它们被永恒者先后派往时间性物质宇宙的创造与（见下文）保存。而在天使品阶的顶端，“神圣十重灵从未离开它们在神圣无限中所居之处”，另一些灵则轮到它们“被置于时间之下，尽管依其本性它们根本不从属于时间”：实际上，它们也被派往这一无限之外，去“执行……时间性的灵性行动”，换言之，去“在超天界、天界与地界中行动与运作”——此即受造宇宙的三个部分（见下文）——因为它们“注定要完成造物主正义与荣耀的时间性显明”。这种被派往神圣无限之外，马丁内斯称之为“释放”（emancipation），绝不可与“流溢”相混淆。流溢曾在永恒中、或至少在“永久”（sempiternity）之中存在，且将永远存在。而释放只在时间之内发生，且仅出于时势的原因。因此，所有三重灵都被释放出去，以照料宇宙的物质事物；此外还有“足够数目”的七重灵，去“在超天界执行时间性的灵性行动”；而其中有些为此“被授予十重权能”，因为十重灵仍留在原处。

body.text: A gap would thus seem to have occurred in the divine immensity, caused by the departure of the ternary spirits; but such a gap is intrinsically impossible, since ‘there cannot be any void next to the Creator or in his immensity’. Thus this place was occupied by a new production, a particularly eminent and glorious one: the “minor quaternary spiritual” – quaternary in the image of the Divinity –, namely Man. He was an emanation directly from the Eternal Himself, just as had been the case with the other spiritual beings; there was no cooperation, as was the case with the temporal creation entrusted to the ternary spirits. Man was then the object of a double emancipation. First, the totality of spiritual beings constituting his class was emancipated in the “supercelestial”. Then a portion of this class was emancipated in the “celestial”, this portion being known by the name of “Adam” or “Réau”: a name that is both collective and individual, but more consistently applied to a unique being containing potentially within itself all of its spiritual posterity. We are told that this name is a pseudonym referring to the nature or state of him who bears it. For ‘this man-God, in his state of glory, had his proper name directly attached to his spiritual being’. Now, in all traditions name is power. The power of Adam, like his glory, was preeminent. ‘He received [from the Creator] the august name of man-God of the universal earth’, he was ‘the chosen god of the earth’. Man, the last to arrive of the emanated spiritual beings, was set above them all for two reasons, which were really only one. First, ‘to contain in privation’ the perverse spirits, to ‘molest’ them, ‘to manifest the divine glory and justice against the prevaricating spirits’; then in order to reconcile them. Their chastisement was not for the sake of punishment, but for repentance. Here Martines, again like Origen, holds firmly to the idea of apocatastasis.
body.zh: 如此看来，由于三重灵的离去，神圣无限中似乎出现了一道空缺；但这样的空缺在本质上有其不可能，因为“在造物主身旁、在他的无限之中，不可能有任何虚空”。于是这个位置被一种新的产物所占据，一种格外卓越而荣耀的产物：“小四重灵性者”——四重，乃依照神性的形象——即人。他是直接来自永恒者自身的流溢，正如其他灵性存在着的情形一样；其中没有合作，不像托付给三重灵的时间性创造那样。人于是成为双重释放的对象。首先，构成其等级的全部灵性存在着在“超天界”中被释放。随后，这一等级的一部分在“天界”中被释放，这一部分以“亚当”（Adam）或“雷奥”（Réau）之名著称：此名既是集体的又是个体的，但更一贯地用于指一个独特的存在者，他自身中潜在地包含着其全部灵性后裔。据说这个名字是一个假名，所指的乃是承载者的本性或状态。因为“这位人神在其荣耀状态中，其专名直接系于其灵性存在”。而在一切传统中，名即是力。亚当的权能如同他的荣耀一样卓越。“他〔从造物主那里〕领受了普世大地之人神这一庄严名号”，他是“大地所拣选的神”。人作为流溢诸灵中最后到来者，被置于它们全体之上，理由有二，而其实只是一个。首先，是要“在匮乏中容纳”那些邪恶之灵，去“骚扰”它们，“针对僭越之灵显明神圣的荣耀与正义”；其次，是为了使它们和解。对它们的惩戒并非为了惩罚，而是为了悔改。在此，马丁内斯再次像奥利金一样，坚定地持守万物复原（apocatastasis）的观念。

body.text: ‘Created in the image and resemblance of the Omnipotent Being’ and placed ‘in the sight of the Divinity’, Adam ‘in his first state of glory was the veritable rival of the Creator. As pure spirit, he openly read the divine thoughts and operations’. The Creator caused him to perform three operations through which he received the Law, then the Precept, and finally the Commandment. After that, the Eternal left him to his free will. Thereupon Adam “prevaricated”, in imitation and at the instigation of the perverse spirits. The latter whispered that he could operate ‘the power of divine creation’inherent in himself. And he in turn found himself, like them, captive in the material prison of which he should have been the jailer. He who should have worked to “reconcile” them would henceforth be at pains to reconcile himself. This possibility had been offered him thanks to the help which which God, in his tireless mercy, supplied him: namely, by ascetic and religious practice. Adam’s place, left vacant in the center of the supercelestial, awaits the moment when he will return to be enthroned there: ‘it is in this holy place that Adam’s minor spiritual posterity must needs be reintegrated’.
body.zh: 亚当“按全能者的形象与相似而受造”，被安置“在神性的注视之下”，“在其最初的荣耀状态中，是造物主名副其实的对手。作为纯粹之灵，他公开地阅读神圣的思想与运作”。造物主使他完成三项运作，借此他先后领受了律法（Law）、训诫（Precept），最后是诫命（Commandment）。此后，永恒者便把他交托给他自己的自由意志。于是亚当“僭越”了，这是效法那些邪恶之灵、并受其怂恿而为之。后者低声对他说，他能够运用自身固有的“神圣创造的权能”。而他也轮到像它们一样，成为物质牢狱中的囚徒，而他本应是那牢狱的看守。他本应致力于使它们“和解”，从此却要费尽心力使自己得蒙和解。这一可能性之所以提供给他，是靠着上帝以其不倦的怜悯所供给的帮助：即借苦修与宗教实践。亚当在超天界中央所留下的空位，等待着有朝一日他重返其中而登座：“正是在这神圣之处，亚当的小灵性后裔必须被重新整合”。

body.text: There remains the fate reserved for another category of spirits, the “octonary” ones. This class, being the second in the angelic hierarchy, does not remain in the divine immensity, nor is it emancipated in a specific region. These spirits are assigned to ‘go and operate [the Creator’s] justice and glory in the different immensities without distinction’. They are as it were the missi dominici (divine envoys) charged to bring help to the deserving: ‘the doubly strong spirit is with you when you deserve it, and it departs from you when you make yourself unworthy of its doubly powerful action’. Their task is to work for reconciliation: in fact, this class of spirits ‘will have to work its powerful faculties eternally in the different classes wherein are placed the first and the last reconciled ones’.
body.zh: 还有另一类灵的命运尚待说明，即“八重”之灵。这一等级在天使品阶中位居第二，既不留在神圣无限之中，也不被释放到某一特定区域。这些灵被指派“无分别地前往不同的无限之中，运作〔造物主的〕正义与荣耀”。它们仿佛是负有使命的巡按使（missi dominici，神圣使者），受命前去援助配得之人：“当你配得之时，那双重强健的灵便与你同在；当你使自己不配于它那双重有力的行动时，它便离你而去”。它们的任务是为和解而工作：事实上，这一等级的灵“将不得不永恒地在不同的等级中运用其强有力的才能，而那些等级中安置着最先得和解者与最后得和解者”。

body.text: It is necessary to take a closer look at the “three immensities” mentioned above. The indispensable traveler’s guide – the ‘road-map of the Elus Coëns’(Ama-dou) – is the famous figure universelle, otherwise called tableau universel, of which several representations exist (Amadou having published in 1974, 1995, and 1999 the only ones conforming with the sources). Martines calls it a ‘universal figure, in which the whole of the spiritual nature – major, minor, and inferior – operates’. Equally valuable is the descriptive commentary provided by Willermoz (published by Amadou as Preface to the Leçons de Lyon, 43-45). A summary follows.
body.zh: 有必要更仔细地考察上文提到的“三重无限”。不可或缺的行路指南——即“选民科恩会的路线图”（阿马杜语）——便是著名的“普遍图形”（figure universelle），又称“普遍图表”（tableau universel），现存若干种图本（阿马杜于1974、1995与1999年刊布的，是唯一与原始文献相符的图本）。马丁内斯称它为“一幅普遍图形，整个灵性自然——大、小与下等——皆在其中运作”。同样有价值的是维勒莫兹所作的描述性评注（由阿马杜作为《里昂课程》的序言刊布，第43—45页）。以下为一概述。

body.text: The “divine immensity” is ‘this place where the most perfect spiritual beings cannot penetrate, if it is not indeed God himself’ – and, we might add, the spiritual beings which he permanently emanates. Next comes the “universal creation” – the cosmos –, composed of the three immensities, or worlds, already mentioned: supercelestial, celestial, and terrestrial. The supercelestial, which abuts and touches the divine immensity, although it is “limited” whereas the latter is infinite, is nevertheless ‘the semblance of it’: ‘the same faculties of spiritual power are found in both immensities’. Four circles are also found therein, just as in the divine immensity. At the top: 1) that of the superior denary spirits (in fact, as we have seen, ‘major spirits . . . clothed with a denary power’); its center is ‘the type and figure of the Divinity whence all emanation and all creation proceeds’. On either side are: 2) the circle of superior septenary spirits, guardians of the divine Law; and 3) the circle of inferior ternary spirits, guardians of the divine spiritual Precept. Lastly and lowest: 4) the circle of minor quaternary spirits, where Man was in the first place emancipated ‘in the sight of God’ and where he will finally be reintegrated when his reconciliation is perfect. Then come the two worlds or immensities that compose the universal creation in the strict sense, which will be discussed below. This creation is material and temporal, that is, constituted of matter and subject to time, matter and time having begun simultaneously after the first prevarication, that of the perverse spirits.
body.zh: “神圣无限”是“最完美的灵性存在着也无法进入的地方，除非那正是上帝本身”——我们还可以补充说，还有他永久流溢而出的那些灵性存在着。接下来是“普遍创造”——即宇宙——，由已经提到的三重无限或三个世界构成：超天界、天界与地界。超天界毗邻并接触神圣无限，尽管它是“有限的”，而后者是无限的，它却仍然是“后者的相似”：“在两个无限之中，可发现同样的灵性权能之能力”。正如在神圣无限中一样，其中也有四个圈层。居顶端者：1）上等十重灵之圈（事实上，如我们所见，即“身披十重权能的大灵”）；其中心是“神性的原型与形象，一切流溢与一切创造皆由此而出”。在其两侧：2）上等七重灵之圈，神圣律法的守护者；以及3）下等三重灵之圈，神圣灵性训诫的守护者。最后，在最下方：4）小四重灵之圈，人最初即在此“在上帝眼前”被释放，而当其和解臻于完美时，他也终将在此被重新整合。随后便是严格意义上的普遍创造所由构成的两个世界或两重无限，下文将加以讨论。这一创造是物质性的与时间性的，即由物质构成并服从于时间；物质与时间是在第一次僭越——即邪恶之灵的僭越——之后同时开始的。

body.text: The universal creation is circumscribed by a mysterious reality called ‘the central fire axis’, which is ‘simultaneously the envelope, the support, and the center of creation’. It is ‘the principle of material life’: it animates and vivifies it. We recall that matter is the result of the combination of three “spirituous essences”: ‘in the same way as the three spirituous essences are the principle of all corporisation, likewise the central fire axis is that of all animation’ (Amadou). It is the principle of individuation and life in all created bodies: ‘without [it] no being can have life and movement’. The reason is that it is ‘the organ of the inferior spirits who inhabit it and who operate in it on the principle of apparent corporeal matter’. These inferior spirits (see above) are the ternary spirits, emancipated for this purpose, who provide for every corporeal being a ‘vehicle of central fire’ (this notion has its counterpart in the theme of the “temple”: ‘all is temple’, writes Martines). Thus ‘no body can exist without having within itself a vehicle of the central fire, on which the inhabitants of this axis operate, as having proceeded from themselves’. It is clearly specified that these vehicles ‘are by no means spiritual beings. They are beings of passive life, destined simply for the preservation of forms. The productions or emanations of the spirits of the axis can only be temporal and momentary’.
body.zh: 普遍创造被一种神秘的事实所界定，这事实名为“中央火轴”，它“同时是创造的包覆、支撑与中心”。它是“物质生命的原则”：它赋予物质以生命，使之有活力。我们记得，物质是三种“精气本质”结合的产物：“正如三种精气本质是一切形体化的原则，中央火轴同样是一切赋灵的原则”（阿马杜）。它是一切受造形体中个体化与生命的原则：“没有〔它〕，任何存在者都不能有生命与运动”。这是因为它是“居于其中、并在其中依表面形体的物质之原则而运作的下等诸灵的器官”。这些下等诸灵（见上文）即为此目的而被释放的三重灵，它们为每一个形体存在者提供一件“中央火之载具”（这一观念在“圣殿”主题中有其对应：“一切都是圣殿”，马丁内斯写道）。因此，“没有任何形体能够存在，除非它自身之中有一件中央火之载具，由这一火轴的居民在其上运作，如同从它们自身而出”。文中明确说明，这些载具“绝不是灵性存在着。它们是受动生命的存在者，仅仅注定用于形式的保存。火轴之灵的产物或流溢只能是时间性的、短暂的”。

body.text: As for the universal creation, thus enveloped by the vivifying central fire axis, it is composed of two immensities or worlds: celestial and terrestrial. The celestial – symbolized by Mount Sinai – is in turn susceptible to two divisions, into which the “seven heavens” are distributed: one ternary, and the other septenary. The ternary division is composed of: 1) the “rational circle” which is ‘adherent to the super-celestial’ via the central fire axis, under the sign of Saturn; 2) the “visual circle”, under the sign of the Sun; 3) the “sensible circle”, under the conjoined signs of Mercury, Mars, Jupiter, Venus, and the Moon. The septenary division, which is superimposed on the preceding one, is the ‘seven planetary circles which contain the seven principal agents of universal nature’, which ‘operate for the conservation and the sustenance of this universe’. These latter are also charged with supressing the ‘evil spiritual beings’, imprisoned in the material universe (as explained above), who ‘combat the faculties of good influential actions which the good planetary spirits are charged to spread around the whole world’. Tossed from one to the other, the minor-man has to choose. One can see here how the principles of traditional →astrology are incorporated in an active angelology, which one might call an “angelomachy” – a battle of good and evil angels –, itself ordered in the eschatological perspective of a sacred History.
body.zh: 至于如此被赋予生命的中央火轴所包覆的普遍创造，它由两重无限或两个世界构成：天界与地界。天界——以西奈山为象征——又可作两种划分，“七重天”即分布其中：一种是三重划分，另一种是七重划分。三重划分由以下构成：1）“理性之圈”，它经由中央火轴“附属于超天界”，在土星的标志之下；2）“视觉之圈”，在太阳的标志之下；3）“可感之圈”，在水星、火星、木星、金星与月亮的联合标志之下。七重划分叠加于前一划分之上，即“七个行星之圈，其中含有普遍自然的七位主要代理者”，它们“为这一宇宙的保存与维系而运作”。后者还受命去压制囚禁于物质宇宙中的“邪恶灵性存在着”（如上文所述），这些恶灵“对抗良好的行星之灵受命向全世界散播的良善影响作用的诸般能力”。小等之人（minor-man）被抛掷于二者之间，必须作出选择。由此可见，传统→占星学的诸原则如何被纳入一种能动的天使论——或可称之为“天使之战”（angelomachy），即善天使与恶天使之战——而这场战争本身又被安排在一部神圣历史的末世论视野之中。

body.text: Finally, just as the four supercelestial circles reflect the ordering of the divine immensity, so the four major celestial circles (those of Saturn, the Sun, Mercury, and Mars) reflect the same ordering. The three other circles, those of Jupiter, Venus, and the Moon, or rather the spirits attached to them, serve to “substantiate” the ‘general terrestrial body’, also called ‘general creation’. From the latter ‘emanate all the nutriments needed to substantiate the particular’, or ‘particular creation’, namely ‘all the inhabitants of the celestial and terrestrial bodies’. Both the general and the particular creation are “triangular” or “ternary” in constitution (see above). It is the same for the “body of matter” of present-day man, which is far different from his primitive “body of glory”.
body.zh: 最后，正如四个超天界之圈映现出神圣无限的秩序，四个主要的天界之圈（即土星、太阳、水星与火星之圈）也映现出同样的秩序。另外三个圈，即木星、金星与月亮之圈，或者更确切地说，附着于它们的诸灵，则用以“实体化”那“普遍的属地之体”，又称“普遍创造”。从后者“流溢出使特殊者实体化所需的一切养分”，这特殊者即“特殊创造”，也就是“天界之体与地界之体中的一切居民”。普遍创造与特殊创造在构成上都是“三角形的”或“三重的”（见上文）。当今之人的“物质之体”也是如此，而这与他原初的“荣耀之体”大不相同。

body.text: Nonetheless – and this is fundamental – Martines tells us insistently ‘not to consider these three circles [sensible, visual, and rational] only materially’. For in reality, the ascent represented by their traversal symbolizes the successive stages of reconciliation of minor-men, at the end of which the latter will be reintegrated in the quaternary supercelestial circle which is waiting for them to repossess it: ‘it is in this holy place that Adam’s minor spiritual posterity is to be reintegrated’. The “great matter” is in fact the ‘Reintegration of beings in their primitive properties, virtues, and divine spiritual powers’ – to quote the title of the Traité. This reintegration requires the disintegration of man’s body of matter, which is his prison, so as to allow his original body of glory to reappear in all its splendor. This great matter, which is that of ‘the mercy of the divine Father towards his creature’, is the universal reconciliation. It is realized progressively, each time a little more completely, at each stage of the sacred History already described. This occurs by means of the operations that the ‘universal Reconciler . . ., the Christ’ – who according to Martines is himself present and active during this whole History under the guise of “types” – ‘had to perform among men for the manifestation of the divine glory, for the salvation of men, and for the molestation of demons. These three operations are: first, that which was done for the reconciliation of Adam; the second, for the reconciliation of the human race, in the year of the world 4000’ – (i.e., with Noah at the time of the Flood, according to traditional chronology); ‘and the third, which shall appear at the end of time and which repeats the first reconciliation of Adam, by reconciling his whole posterity with the Creator’.
body.zh: 然而——这一点至关重要——马丁内斯反复告诫我们“不要仅仅从物质层面来看待这三个圈〔可感之圈、视觉之圈与理性之圈〕”。因为在实际上，穿越它们所代表的上升，象征着众小等之人所经历的和解的各个相继阶段，在此过程的终点，他们将重新整合于那等待他们重新占有它的四重超天界之圈：“正是在这神圣之处，亚当的小灵性后裔将得重新整合”。所谓“大事”（the great matter），实际上就是“诸存在者恢复其原初属性、德能与神圣灵性权能的重新整合”——借用《论重新整合》的标题。这一重新整合要求人的物质之体解体，那身体是他的牢狱，从而使他原初的荣耀之体得以以其全部光辉重新显现。这桩大事，即“神圣之父对其造物的怜悯”之事，便是普遍和解。它逐步实现，在已经描述过的神圣历史的每一阶段，每次都更为完整一些。这是通过“普遍的和解者……基督”的运作而实现的——据马丁内斯说，基督本人在整部历史中都以“预表”（types）的形态临在并活动——这些运作他“必须在人中施行，为显明神圣的荣耀，为拯救人，并为骚扰诸魔。这三项运作是：第一项，为亚当的和解而施行者；第二项，为人类种族的和解而施行者，在世界的第4000年”——（即按传统编年，为洪水时期的挪亚）；“以及第三项，将在时间的终末显现，它重复亚当的第一次和解，将他全部的后裔与造物主和解”。

body.text: 2. The Cult
body.zh: 2. 崇拜

body.text: This doctrine, which forms a whole and includes everything from God down to man and the material universe, does not exist primarily for theory, but is meant to be put into practice. For every minor-man, it is a question of entering into possession of all the arguments of the case in order to effect this reconciliation and reintegration, first for his own sake but also for the sake of universal creation. This reintegration, as the etymology shows, will be the return to the original integrity, the primal unity. This is the goal that Martines set for his Order, first called “Ordre des Élus Coëns de Josué”, then “Ordre des Chevaliers Maçons Élus Coëns de l’Univers”. It appeared to be a masonic and chivalric Order, but this was merely for practical purposes, so as to offer to seekers unsatisfied by other Systems a real spiritual goal, capable of obtaining (as Willermoz wrote when this goal was revealed to him) ‘that inner peace of the soul, the most precious possession of humanity, relatively to his being and his principle’. However, the attempt to implant the Order in the field of French masonry was, as we know, a failure, because the foundation was so different from the appearances.
body.zh: 这一教义自成一体，从上帝一直涵盖到人与物质宇宙，它的存在主要不是为了理论，而是要付诸实践。对每一个小等之人而言，问题在于掌握案件的全部论据，以实现这一和解与重新整合，首先是为自己，同时也是为了普遍创造。这一重新整合，正如词源所显示，将是返回原初的完整，返回原初的统一。这就是马丁内斯为其修会所设定的目标；该会初名“约书亚选民科恩会”（Ordre des Élus Coëns de Josué），后称“宇宙选民科恩骑士共济会”（Ordre des Chevaliers Maçons Élus Coëns de l’Univers）。它表面上是一个共济会的与骑士的修会，但这仅仅出于实际的考虑，为的是向那些不满足于其他体系（Systems）的寻求者提供一个真实的灵性目标，这一目标能够获得（如维勒莫兹在此目标向他启示时所写的）“灵魂的那种内在平安，就人的存在与其本原而言，这是人类最珍贵的财富”。然而，如我们所知，试图把这一修会移植到法国共济会的领域之中，是一次失败，因为其根基与表象如此不同。

body.text: Martines expounded the final goal of the Order thus, replying in 1769 to Willermoz’s questionings: ‘The Order contains a true science, it is founded on truth pure and simple, it is impossible for sophistry to reign or for charlatanry to preside there. On the contrary, error lasts but a moment, it flees and truth remains’. And further on: ‘I swear to you that you will not have to ask me much more to be convinced that the Order contains for the minor of this lowly world things that are most necessary and essential for his advantage; so the Order seeks the man of desire, and when he lets himself be led, he is content’ (Van Rijnberk, vol. II, 120). Earlier, in 1768, Martines had declared to Willermoz: ‘I am only a feeble instrument which God wishes to use, unworthy as I am, to recall men, my fellows, to their first masonic state, which spiritually means man or soul, so as to make them see truly that they are really man-God, being created in the image and semblance of this all-powerful Being’ (ibid. II 89). This was far from the ‘amiable sociability’ enjoyed by many of the masonic lodges of the time!
body.zh: 马丁内斯在1769年回答维勒莫兹的疑问时，如此阐述修会的最终目标：“修会含有一种真正的科学，它建立在纯粹而单纯的真理之上，诡辩不可能在其中称王，江湖骗术也不可能在其中主事。相反，谬误只持续一瞬，它逃遁而去，真理留存下来。”他接着又说：“我向你保证，你不必再多问我什么，就会确信：修会为这卑微世界的小等之人含有对其利益最为必要、最为本质的东西；因此修会所寻找的是那有渴望的人，而当他让自己被引导时，他便满足了”（范·赖恩贝克，第II卷，第120页）。更早一些，在1768年，马丁内斯曾向维勒莫兹宣称：“我不过是上帝愿意使用的一件软弱工具，尽管我不配，他要借我把人、把我的同类唤回他们最初的共济会状态——在灵性上这意味着人或灵魂——好使他们真正看到，他们确实是真正的人神，是按这全能者的形象与相似而受造的”（同上，II，第89页）。这与当时许多共济会会所所享有的“和蔼的社交”相去何其远！

body.text: The two terms in the title of the Order should be noted. “Élu” (chosen, elect) is only superficially reminiscent of the innumerable degrees of “élus” invented at the time. The term refers in fact to the spiritual phenomenon of “divine election”, through which the Eternal chooses and sets apart a man, or a people, in view of a mission which He assigns to it. This choice is sovereign, gratuitous, and often incomprehensible to men, but God is not accountable to anyone. Just as in sacred History there is a “chosen people”, so there is a long line of chosen ones: Noah, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, →Moses, the prophets (including Elijah and John the Baptist), right up to the apostle Paul. It is easy to see why they all figure in the ceremonies of the Order. Martines in fact claimed for the latter an origin as ancient as the universe, thus far older than masonry: ‘Remember, Lord, this Society that Thou hast formed and possessed from the beginning’, says a ritual invocation. The other essential term is “coën”, which means “priest”. But a priest of what religion? Certainly the word is Hebrew, but a Coën is not a Cohen, the Coëns are not Cohanim, the priests of the Mosaic religion formerly celebrated in the Temple of Jerusalem, and which disappeared at the same time as the Temple, to be replaced by the ceremonies of the synagogues. If one believes the Gospel – and the Coëns did so – this disappearance was final. The cult celebrated by the Élus Coëns is quite different. It is the ‘primitive cult confided by the Eternal to Adam and perpetuated by the minor elect until our day in the Ordre des Coëns, which is identified with the Ordre des Élus de l’Eternel [Order of the Elect of the Eternal] or to the High and Holy Order of which Jean-Baptiste Willermoz speaks in the Instructions which have nothing secret but their name’ (Laurent Morlet). As is taught in the 99th Leçon de Lyon: ‘The true ceremonial cult was taught to Adam after his fall by the reconciling Angel; it was piously performed by his son Abel in his presence, re-established by Enoch who taught new disciples, then forgotten by the whole earth and restored by Noah and his children; again renovated by Moses, David, Solomon, and Zorobabel, and brought to final perfection by Christ in the midst of his twelve Apostles at the Last Supper’. As one can see, Solomon and Zorobabel, figures well known to masons, are here inserted from a radically different perspective.
body.zh: 修会名称中的两个词值得注意。“选民”（Élu，被拣选者、蒙选者）只是在表面上令人想起当时所发明的无数“选民”等级。这个词实际上指的是“神圣拣选”这一灵性现象：永恒者借此拣选并分别出一个人，或一个民族，以承担他所指派的一项使命。这种拣选是至高无上的、无偿的，且往往对人而言不可理解，但上帝不对任何人负责。正如神圣历史中有一个“选民”，也有一长串蒙拣选者：挪亚、亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各、→摩西、众先知（包括以利亚与施洗约翰），直到使徒保罗。不难明白，为什么他们全都出现在修会的仪式之中。事实上，马丁内斯为修会主张一种与宇宙同样古老的起源，因而远早于共济会：“主啊，请记念你自起初便已形成并拥有的这个社团”，一则仪式祷文如此说。另一个关键术语是“科恩”（coën），意为“祭司”。但这是何种宗教的祭司？这个词当然源自希伯来语，然而一个科恩并非一个 Cohen，科恩们并非 Cohanim，即并非摩西宗教的祭司——那宗教曾于耶路撒冷圣殿中举行祭祀，并随圣殿一同消亡，为会堂的仪式所取代。若相信福音书——而科恩们确实相信——这一消亡便是最终的。选民科恩所举行的崇拜完全不同。它是“永恒者托付给亚当、并由小选民一直延续至今的原始崇拜，存于科恩修会之中，此修会亦即‘永恒者选民会’（Ordre des Élus de l’Eternel），或让-巴蒂斯特·维勒莫兹在其《训令》中所言的那个崇高神圣的修会，而那些《训令》除了名称之外毫无秘密可言”（洛朗·莫尔莱，Laurent Morlet）。正如《里昂第九十九课》所教导的：“真正的仪式崇拜是在亚当堕落之后由和解天使教给他的；他曾在他的儿子亚伯在场时虔诚地举行；由以诺重新建立，以诺又教导了新的门徒；后来被全地遗忘，又由挪亚及其子女恢复；再由摩西、大卫、所罗门与所罗巴伯加以更新，最终由基督在其十二使徒中间、在最后的晚餐上臻于完善”。如人所见，所罗门与所罗巴伯——共济会所熟知的人物——在此被置入一个截然不同的视野之中。

body.text: In truth, ‘the Order is sacerdotal’ (Amadou). Its raison d’être is to perform this cult which was originally entrusted to man, and which has not been taken from him; it is just that its procedures, especially the ceremonial ones, have changed. This cult is “quatriple” or quadruple, consisting of: 1) sanctification, corresponding to the divine Thought or to the Father; 2) reconciliation, corresponding to the divine Will or to the Word; 3) purification, corresponding to the divine Action or to the Holy Spirit; 4) expiation, corresponding to the divine Operation or to Man. However, ‘Man in his first state only had to perform a cult of sanctification and praise. He was the agent through which the spirits whom he was supposed to retrieve’ – the perverse, prevaricating spirits – ‘were to perform the three others. Having fallen, he had to perform them for himself’.
body.zh: 事实上，“修会是祭司性的”（阿马杜）。它存在的理由就在于举行这一原初托付给人的崇拜，而这崇拜并未从人那里被夺去；只是其程序，尤其是仪式程序，已经改变。这一崇拜是“四重的”，由以下构成：1）圣化，对应神圣的思想或圣父；2）和解，对应神圣的意志或圣言；3）净化，对应神圣的行动或圣灵；4）赎罪，对应神圣的运作或人。然而，“人在其最初状态中只需举行圣化与赞美的崇拜。他是中介，那些他本应挽回的灵”——即邪恶的、僭越的诸灵——“本应通过他举行另外三者。既已堕落，他便必须为自己举行这三者”。

body.text: Since the Order was sacerdotal, the receptions into the various degrees are not “initiations”, like those found in the masonic systems, but rather “ordinations”. As Serge Caillet explains it, each of these ordinations impresses on him who receives it ‘a spiritual seal, the characteristic mark of divine election, which makes the Coën a priest of this original cult’. And it is the spirits who confer on the recipient the reality of his ordination, each according to its class: denary, octonary, or septenary, corresponding (cf. above) to the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Through them, the Coën is conjoined, or one might say put in communion, with the Chosen One of the Eternal, whether patriarch or prophet, who presides over the class into which he is admitted. It is from this Chosen One ‘that he receives the name, the spiritual influx, the seal of his own election’ (L. Morlet). Each of the elections successively received within the Order is in fact placed under the active and efficacious patronage of one of these Chosen Ones of the Eternal: Adam, Abraham, Moses, Zorababel, Jesus Christ. This Chosen One, with whom the Élu Coën is conjoined, will henceforth cooperate “sympathetically” with him in the ceremonial operations, as long as the latter fulfill the exacting conditions that are required; but this cooperation will always take place through the mediation or intercession of the spirits – angels – who are the vehicles of the divine influxes or energies.
body.zh: 既然修会是祭司性的，那么进入各等级的仪式便不是“入门”（initiations），不像共济会诸体系中的那样，而是“授职”（ordinations）。如塞尔日·卡耶（Serge Caillet）所解释的，每一次授职都在领受者身上印下“一种灵性印记，即神圣拣选的特征标记，使科恩成为这一原初崇拜的祭司”。而赋予领受者其授职之实在的，正是诸灵，各依其等级：十重的、八重的或七重的，分别对应（参见上文）圣父、圣子与圣灵。通过它们，科恩便与永恒者的某位蒙拣选者——无论宗祖还是先知——相联结，或可说被置入共融之中，而这位蒙拣选者主持着他所进入的那个等级。正是从这位蒙拣选者那里，“他领受名号、灵性注入以及他自己蒙拣选的印记”（L. 莫尔莱）。事实上，在修会内相继领受的每一次拣选，都置于永恒者某位蒙拣选者的能动而有效的护佑之下：亚当、亚伯拉罕、摩西、所罗巴伯、耶稣基督。这位与选民科恩相联结的蒙拣选者，从此将以“同情”（sympathetically）的方式与他协同举行仪式运作，只要后者满足所要求的严格条件；但这种合作始终要通过诸灵——天使——的中介或代祷而发生，而它们是神圣注入或能量的载具。

body.text: This is the source of the “passes”, so famous but so often misunderstood. These “luminous glyphs”, said to appear during the ritual, were by no means the object of the Coëns’ ceremonies, contrarily to what has often been thought. The aim of these ceremonies is to pierce through the phenomenal plane to reach and transform the being of man, so as to set in motion his reconciliation, and at the same time that of the universe. In this perspective, the “passes” are believed to be the sensible marks of the divine favor, confirming that the procedure is true, that “the man of desire” is desiring aright. Thus they are not phenomena that one can produce at will or on demand. They are favors given by grace, as Martines reminded Willermoz in the letter cited above, from 1768: ‘Do not be impatient, bide your time. This sort of thing is not at the disposal of man alone, but rather at that of the Most High and Omnipotent Eternal’ (Van Rijnberk, op. cit. 89).
body.zh: “光符”（passes）即由此而来，它们如此著名，却又如此常被误解。与人们通常所想相反，据说在仪式中出现的这些“发光的字符”，绝非科恩们仪式的目的所在。这些仪式的目的，是穿透现象界，抵达并转化人的存在，从而启动他的和解，同时也启动宇宙的和解。在此视野中，“光符”被认为是神圣恩宠的可感标记，确认程序是真实的，确认“有渴望的人”的渴望是正当的。因此，它们不是可以随意或按需产生的现象。它们是恩典所赐的恩惠，正如马丁内斯在上述1768年的书信中提醒维勒莫兹的那样：“不要急躁，等待你的时机。这类事情并非单凭人就可支配，而是由至高全能的永恒者支配”（范·赖恩贝克，同上，第89页）。

body.text: The active and beneficent divine reality which thus epiphanizes itself was mysteriously known by Martines, and after him by his disciples, as La Chose (the Thing). What is the Thing? Much has been written about it, and much erroneously. According to Amadou, ‘the Thing is not the person of Jesus Christ . . ., the Thing is not Jesus Christ, it is the presence of Jesus Christ, as the Shekinah was the presence of God in the Holy of Holies’. What has scarcely been noticed, as pointed out by Laurent Morlet, is that the Hebrew word for “thing” is DaBaR, which primarily signifies “word”, secondarily “thing”, and thirdly “cause”. It appears from this that the Thing is nothing less than the Creator Word, that Word which the Coëns’ Instructions also qualified as Mediator: in short, Christ Jesus. It was certainly not for nothing that the Order was originally called the Ordre des Elus Coëns de Josué, for in Hebrew Joshua and Jesus are the same name. Thus the Coën is ‘a partisan of the true Wisdom’, as Martines proclaims, asserting unequivocally that this same Wisdom has ‘dictated . . . the knowledge [that he] professes’. This Wisdom, which Saint-Martin would celebrate without any divergence from his master’s thought under its traditional name of Sophia, thus presides over the Order and all its works. That is why these are, as has been said, theosophy, anthroposophy, cosmosophy, chronosophy, and sophianic liturgy. Moreover, in the Christian tradition to which Martines’disciples belonged who gathered on the occasion of the Leçons de Lyon, Wisdom typifies the Creator Word.
body.zh: 如此自行显现的那种能动的、施恩的神圣实在，被马丁内斯以及在他之后的弟子们神秘地称为“那物”（La Chose）。那物是什么？关于它已有许多著述，其中许多是错误的。据阿马杜说，“那物不是耶稣基督的位格……那物不是耶稣基督，而是耶稣基督的临在，正如舍金纳是上帝在至圣所中的临在”。而如洛朗·莫尔莱所指出的，几乎无人注意到：希伯来语中“物”一词是 DaBaR，其主要含义为“言”，其次为“物”，第三为“因”。由此看来，那物不外是造物之言，即科恩们的《训令》同样称之为“中保”的那言：简言之，就是基督耶稣。修会最初被称为“约书亚选民科恩会”绝非偶然，因为在希伯来语中，约书亚与耶稣是同一个名字。因此，科恩是“真正智慧的追随者”，如马丁内斯所宣告的，并毫不含糊地断言，这同一智慧“口授了〔他所〕宣示的知识”。这智慧，圣马丁日后将以其传统名称索菲亚来颂扬，而与其师的思想毫无分歧，它如此主持着修会及其一切事工。正因如此，这些事工才如上文所说，是神智学、人智论、宇宙智慧论、时间智慧论与索菲亚式的礼仪。此外，在马丁内斯弟子们所属的基督教传统中——他们曾因《里昂课程》而聚集——智慧象征着造物之言。

body.text: The “passes” have another purpose: they are signals, even signatures, of the spirits who “activate” in cooperation with the celebrant. The latter is provided with a collection of 2400 diagrams and as many names of angels (in Hebrew) – brought to light by Robert Amadou and published by him under the appropriate title of Angéliques
body.zh: “光符”还有另一个用途：它们是那些与主祭者协同“运作”的诸灵的信号，甚至是签名。主祭者备有一套两千四百幅图形，以及同样数目的天使名号（以希伯来文书写）——这些由罗贝尔·阿马杜发掘出来，并由他以《Angéliques》这一恰如其分的标题刊布

body.text: – diagrams permitting the identification of the angels who are at work. In short, the Coën ceremonial is a liturgy that is truly co-celebrated by angels and men.
body.zh: ——这些图形使人得以辨认出正在运作的天使。简言之，科恩的仪式是一种真正由天使与人共同举行的礼仪。

body.text: This liturgy should in no way be identified or even compared with a liturgy of the ecclesiastical type. What is believed to be operative in it is the primitive cosmic priesthood with which Adam, the first Man, was endowed. The Coën is devoted to the “primitive cult” aiming at the reconciliation of man and of the creation – of man with God, man with the creation, and the creation with God. And in order to do this, the Réau-Croix, identified both with the first, fallen Adam, and with Christ, the new Adam, universal Redeemer and Repairer, recapitulates in and through himself the stage of fall and “privation”. The Coën cult thus does not rival that of the Church, does not substitute for it or surpass it: it presupposes it and harmonizes with it. This is the reason why Martines obliged the Coëns to practice the ceremonies and receive the sacraments of the Church.
body.zh: 这一礼仪绝不应被等同于、甚至不应被比作教会类型的礼仪。在其中被认为发生效力的，是亚当——第一人——所禀有的原初宇宙祭司职。科恩献身于“原初崇拜”，其目标是人及受造界的和解——人与上帝、人与受造界、以及受造界与上帝的和解。而为了做到这一点，雷奥十字（Réau-Croix）——他既与堕落的第一亚当相认同，也与基督、新亚当、普遍救赎者与修复者相认同——在自身之中并通过自身，总括了堕落与“匮乏”的阶段。因此，科恩的崇拜并不与教会的崇拜相竞争，不取代它，也不超越它：它以之为前提，并与之和谐一致。正因如此，马丁内斯才要求科恩们奉行教会的仪式并领受教会的圣事。

body.text: Moreover, just as the Church’s priests, beside the ceremonies of their cult, must also devote themselves to personal prayer, both spontaneous and regulated, that is, in rhythm dictated by rule (the offices of the monastic or canonical Hours, reading the Breviary and the Holy Scriptures), likewise these priests of a particular kind who are the Coëns are obliged every six hours to say prayers modeled (with adaptations) on those same offices, not to mention various other offices to be celebrated following the calendar (days of the week, phases of the moon, seasons . . .). In addition, they must follow rules of diet (fasting) and practice a real moral and mental ascesis. In sum, the Coën is a priest and the Coën rule of life is an ascesis. And the Coën doctrine, which can truly be called a theosophy and an anthroposophy, is ordered to this end: to make the Coën, in his accomplished state which is that of Réau-Croix, fully capable of working for the universal reconciliation.
body.zh: 此外，正如教会的司祭在其崇拜仪式之外，也必须致力于个人的祈祷，既有自发的，也有规定的，即按规则所定的节律（修道院或咏礼的日课，诵读日课经与圣经）；同样，这些特殊种类的司祭——即科恩们——也必须每六个时辰诵念一次仿照那些日课（并加以调整）的祈祷，更不必说依历法（一周的各日、月相、季节……）而举行的其他各种日课。此外，他们还必须遵守饮食规则（斋戒），并实践一种真正的伦理与心神的苦修。总之，科恩是司祭，而科恩的生活规则是一种苦修。而科恩的教义——它确实可被称为一种神智学与一种人智论——正是为此目的而安排的：使科恩在其成全的状态、即雷奥十字的状态中，完全有能力为普遍和解而工作。

body.text: 3. The Legacy
body.zh: 3. 遗产

body.text: The destinies of the Ordre des Elus Coëns, apparently fairly unfruitful, are described elsewhere [→ Pasqually; →Elus Coëns]. The Order contained few members, and suffered a kind of official ostracism. Nonetheless, it continued to arouse curiosity, as on the occasion of the Convent des Philalèthes (1785 and 1787). Also significant is the interest, lasting if sporadic, on the part of Bacon de la Chevalerie, a highly placed Mason in the Grand Orient de France, whom Martines had named as his universal Substitute. Willermoz, who by common consent was the real preserver of the Order, was assailed by indiscreet requests which he could not always reject.
body.zh: 选民科恩会的命运表面上看相当不结果实，其情形另见他处［→帕斯夸利；→选民科恩会］。修会成员寥寥，并遭受某种官方的排斥。然而它仍不断引起好奇，如在“爱智会大会”（Convent des Philalèthes，1785与1787年）之际。同样值得注意的是，法兰西大东方会中位居高位的共济会员培根·德·拉·舍瓦勒里（Bacon de la Chevalerie）对它抱持的兴趣——这种兴趣虽时断时续，却持续甚久；马丁内斯曾指定他为自己的普遍代理人（Substitute）。而众所公认的真正保全了修会的人维勒莫兹，则受到种种不知分寸的请求的困扰，他并不总能一一拒绝。

body.text: Willermoz in fact managed to preserve for a time the legacy of the master to whom he remained faithful until his death. He preserved it in a way that the latter would surely have disapproved of. Convinced that this System, which was more crypto-masonic than masonic, was doomed as such, he concealed it within the hybrid System, both masonic and chivalric, that he himself invented, namely the Régime Ecossais Rectifié. We must make clear that the Ordre des Elus Coëns de l’Univers is not part of the Régime Ecossais Rectifié; but it is nevertheless at the heart of the latter, and even is its “heart” (Amadou). The Régime teaches the same doctrine, the same “science of man”, but without practicing any liturgical ceremony, and does not even speak of it except in covert terms to the Grands Profès (the highest degree of the R.E.R.). ‘The Régime Ecossais Rectifié lives only by the doctrine of reintegration and for reintegration, like the Ordre des Elus Coëns. Between the two of them, the modus operandi differs’ (Amadou). In the Régime, only Masons and Knights appear. If there are Coëns present, it is not in that capacity, but incognito.
body.zh: 事实上，维勒莫兹在一段时间内成功地保存了他至死忠信的那位导师的遗产。而他的保存方式，那位导师本人肯定会加以非难。他确信这一与其说是共济会的、不如说是隐秘共济会的体系（System）作为这样的体系注定要消亡，于是便把它隐藏在他自己所发明的那个兼具共济会与骑士性质的混合体系——即苏格兰修正礼制——之中。必须说明，宇宙选民科恩会并不属于苏格兰修正礼制的一部分；然而它仍处于后者的核心，甚至就是其“心脏”（阿马杜）。修正礼制教导同样的教义、同样的“关于人的科学”，但不举行任何礼仪仪式，甚至除对大誓士（Grands Profès，即修正礼制的最高等级）以隐晦的措辞提及之外，根本不谈它。“苏格兰修正礼制如同选民科恩会一样，只靠重新整合的教义而活，并为重新整合而活。二者之间，运作方式（modus operandi）有所不同”（阿马杜）。在修正礼制中，只出现共济会员与骑士。若有科恩在场，并非以那一身份，而是隐姓埋名。

body.text: This creation of Willermoz was of capital importance for Martinesism. It was in the bosom of the Régime Ecossais Rectifié that its survival was assured, at least in its doctrinal form, after the disintegration of the Ordre Coën. All the “instructions” officially dispensed, from that of Apprentice up to Grand Profès, taught Martines’ doctrine step by step, in an increasingly overt fashion. Willermoz declared it explicitly in a letter of 1812: ‘The initiation of the Grands Profès instructs the tested mason, the man of desire, about the origin and formation of the physical universe, its destination and the occasional cause of its creation at a certain moment and at no other; the emanation and emancipation of man in a glorious form, and his sublime destination at the center of created things; his prevarication, his fall, the benefit and absolute necessity of the Incarnation of the Word itself for the Redemption, etc.’
body.zh: 维勒莫兹的这一创造对马丁主义至关重要。正是在苏格兰修正礼制的怀抱中，马丁主义在科恩修会解体之后得以存续，至少在其教义形态上如此。所有正式颁授的“训令”，从学徒的直到大誓士的，都逐步地、越来越公开地教导马丁内斯的教义。维勒莫兹在1812年的一封信中明确说明了这一点：“大誓士的入门，向经过考验的共济会员、即有渴望的人，讲授物质宇宙的起源与形成、它的归宿，以及它在某一时刻而非其他时刻被创造的那一偶然原因；人在荣耀形态中的流溢与释放，以及他在受造物中央的崇高归宿；他的僭越、他的堕落、圣言本身道成肉身对于救赎的裨益与绝对必要性，等等。”

body.text: Even so, the most outstanding disciples of Martines, namely →Louis-Claude de Saint-Martin and Jean-Jacques Du Roy d’Hauterive, who organized the Leçons de Lyon with Willermoz himself from 1774 to 1776, did not hold to his System for very long. Hauterive withdrew to his little Coën group in Toulouse, and “de-masonized” the ceremonies to simplify them and reduce them to the purest spiritual →alchemy. Saint-Martin, for his part, chose a purely internal path, known since Papus under the odd name of the “cardiac way”, otherwise the “way of the heart”, where prayer takes precedence over all ceremonial forms as a method of spiritual realization. Already while he was with Martines, Saint-Martin had a certain suspicion of the rituals, hence his well-known question: ‘Master, does it really take all these forms to pray to the good God?’ The reply is less well known, and gives food for thought: ‘One should be content with what one has’. Later, in Ecce Homo, Saint-Martin would severely denounce the ‘outer manifestations or movements’, declaring: ‘The works that result from them are, so to speak, the shadows of works, works of the surface, and consequently not sufficiently enlivening to link with the plan of God’s great work, which is to recall us to our inner center where God is to be found, instead of dividing ourselves into centers that are external, fragile, obscure, or corrupt, where God is not to be found’. For all that, Saint-Martin remained convinced all his life, if not of the utility of Martines’ practices then at least of the truth of his doctrine, which he continued to deepen even after his discovery from 1788 onwards of →Jacob Boehme, who opened new horizons to him. He then set himself to “marry” his two masters, as he put it. He made himself the efficient and constant propagator of this doctrine, performing this task as co-author, in the function of secretary, of the Traité sur la Réintégration, as well as in the many documents, rituals, and instructions needed for the life of the Order; also by putting out many of the Leçons de Lyon; by publishing (under the pseudonym of Philosophe Inconnu [Unknown Philosopher]) the books Des erreurs et de la vérité (On Errors and Truth, 1775) and Tableau naturel des rapports qui existent entre Dieu, l’homme et l’univers (Natural Table of the Relationships that Exist between God, Man, and the Universe, 1782), which are quasi-official expositions of the doctrine. Even afterwards, this continued to inspire all his works right up to his death: L’Homme de désir (The Man of Desire, 1790), Ecce Homo (Behold the Man, 1792), Le Nouvel Homme (The New Man, 1792), and Le Ministère de l’Homme-Esprit (The Ministry of the SpiritMan, 1802). His thought is fundamentally the reflection of Martines’: a faithful reflection, although enriched by his own personality as well as by a theosophy in which the role of theurgy is much reduced, even absent, or else totally interiorized and spiritualized. Without a doubt, his literary work has been an efficient vehicle for the diffusion of the doctrine. It is principally thanks to Saint-Martin’s interpretations that Martinesian concepts found a ready response among the French Romantic writers: Chateaubriand (on whom, however, they made little impression), much more → Ballanche, and equally Balzac (who “married” Saint-Martin to →
body.zh: 即便如此，马丁内斯最杰出的弟子们——即→路易-克洛德·德·圣马丁与让-雅克·杜·鲁瓦·德·奥特里夫（Jean-Jacques Du Roy d’Hauterive），后者曾与维勒莫兹本人一起，于1774至1776年间组织《里昂课程》——并未长久持守他的体系。奥特里夫退回到他在图卢兹的小型科恩团体，并把仪式“去共济会化”，加以简化，使之归于最纯粹的灵性→炼金术。圣马丁则选择了一条纯粹内在的道路，自帕普斯以来，这条道路以“心脏之路”（voie cardiaque）这一奇特名称著称，又称“心之路”；在这条路上，祈祷作为灵性实现的方法，优先于一切仪式形式。早在跟随马丁内斯之时，圣马丁对仪式便有所疑虑，因此有他那句著名的问题：“导师，向善上帝祈祷真的需要所有这些形式吗？”回答则不那么著名，且耐人寻味：“人应当满足于自己所有的。”后来，在《Ecce Homo》中，圣马丁严厉斥责“外在的表现或动作”，宣称：“由它们所产生的作品，可以说是作品的影子，是表面的作品，因而不足以赋予生命，无法与上帝伟大工程的计划相联结——那工程就是要使我们返回内在的中心，上帝将在那里被寻见，而不是使我们分散到那些外在的、脆弱的、幽暗的或败坏的中心去，上帝并不在那里。”尽管如此，圣马丁终其一生都确信——即使不确信马丁内斯那些实践的效用，至少确信其教义的真理——并且不断深化它，甚至在他自1788年起发现→雅各布·波墨、后者向他开启了新的视野之后仍然如此。他于是着手“撮合”他的两位导师，如他所说。他成为这一教义高效而恒常的传播者：以秘书的身份作为《论重新整合》的合著者完成这一工作，也在修会生活所需的许多文件、仪式与训令中如此；他还整理出《里昂课程》中的许多部分；并以“未知哲学家”（Philosophe Inconnu）为笔名出版了《论谬误与真理》（Des erreurs et de la vérité，1775）与《上帝、人与宇宙之间关系的自然图表》（Tableau naturel des rapports qui existent entre Dieu, l’homme et l’univers，1782），这两部书堪称该教义的准官方阐述。此后，这一教义继续启迪他的全部著作，直至他去世：《渴望之人》（L’Homme de désir，1790）、《Ecce Homo》（1792）、《新人》（Le Nouvel Homme，1792）以及《灵性之人的事奉》（Le Ministère de l’Homme-Esprit，1802）。他的思想根本上是马丁内斯思想的反映：一种忠实的反映，尽管因他本人的个性而更为丰富，也因一种神智学而更为丰富——在其中，神术（theurgy）的作用大为减弱，甚至缺席，或者被完全内在化、灵性化。毫无疑问，他的文学著作是传播这一教义的有效载体。主要正是由于圣马丁的阐释，马丁内斯式的概念才在法国浪漫派作家中得到热切回应：夏多布里昂（Chateaubriand，不过这些概念对他影响甚微）、影响大得多的→巴朗什（Ballanche），以及同样如此的巴尔扎克（他把圣马丁与→

body.text: Swedenborg), Lamennais, Sainte-Beuve, Hugo, and →Nerval; and also in German writers: →Schelling, Zacharias Werner, and the Schlegel brother. On the sidelines we might also list Sébastien Mercier, author in the Tableaux de Paris (Pictures of Paris, 1783) of the first report on the “Martinists”; also Madame de Staël with her De l’Allemagne (On Germany, 1813); and lastly, though more subservient to literary fashion, →Cazotte, Charles Nodier, George Sand, and Alexandre Dumas. →Joseph de Maistre occupies a place to himself: for all that he was a Roman Catholic and a papist, he presented in his Soirées de Saint-Pétersbourg (Saint Petersburg Evenings, 1821), under the guise of a controversy for and against →“illuminism”, an excellent defence and illustration of Martinist ideas. He never abjured them, to the point (as Jean-Marc Vivenza has recently shown, op. cit., 64-67) of regularly performing the “operations” of the Order at the propitious calendrical moments, even in the heat of the Revolution. So it was through Willermoz and Saint-Martin, or their joint influence, that the doctrine of reintegration and all that goes with it has been perpetuated up to the present day. Thus, for example, in Russia at the end of the 18th and beginning of the 19th century the noun “Martinism” and the adjective “Martinist” carried several meanings, serving to designate: 1) the Régime Ecossais Rectifié, introduced into that country after the Convent of Wilhelmsbad (1782); 2) the theosophy of Martines; 3) the theosophy of Saint-Martin (some of his works having been published in Russian thanks to → Novikov and →Lopukhin); 4) in a vague but current manner, all these three senses at once.
body.zh: 斯威登堡“撮合”起来）；此外还有拉默内（Lamennais）、圣伯夫（Sainte-Beuve）、雨果，以及→奈瓦尔（Nerval）；在德国作家中亦然：→谢林、扎哈里亚斯·维尔纳（Zacharias Werner）与施莱格尔兄弟中的一位。在边缘处，我们还可举出塞巴斯蒂安·梅西耶（Sébastien Mercier），他在《巴黎图景》（Tableaux de Paris，1783）中写下了关于“马丁主义者”的最早报道；还有斯塔尔夫人（Madame de Staël）及其《论德国》（De l’Allemagne，1813）；最后，虽然更多是迎合文学时尚的，还有→卡佐特（Cazotte）、夏尔·诺迪耶（Charles Nodier）、乔治·桑（George Sand）与亚历山大·大仲马（Alexandre Dumas）。→约瑟夫·德·迈斯特（Joseph de Maistre）则自成一格：尽管他是罗马天主教徒、教皇至上论者，他却在《圣彼得堡之夜》（Soirées de Saint-Pétersbourg，1821）中，以一场支持与反对→“光照派”的论辩为形式，对马丁主义观念作了出色的辩护与阐发。他从未弃绝这些观念，甚至（如让-马克·维文扎新近所表明的，同上，第64—67页）在革命最炽烈之时，也依旧在历法上合宜的时刻定期举行修会的“运作”。因此，正是通过维勒莫兹与圣马丁，或通过他们共同的影响，重新整合的教义及与之相关的一切才一直延续至今。例如，在18世纪末与19世纪初的俄国，“马丁主义”这一名词与“马丁主义者”这一形容词便含有数种含义，用以指称：1）在威廉斯巴德大会（1782）之后传入该国的苏格兰修正礼制；2）马丁内斯的神智学；3）圣马丁的神智学（其部分著作因→诺维科夫与→洛普欣之力而以俄文出版）；4）以一种含混而通行的方式，同时指上述三种含义。

body.text: It should be added that all forms of Martinism then suffered a long eclipse. The works of Saint-Martin lacked a readership until they were brought back to light at the end of the 19th century by → Papus; the Traité de la réintégration (Treatise on Reintegration), which up to then had only circulated in manuscript form, was first published only in 1899; it was not until 1926 that the Instructions secrètes aux Profès (Secret Instructions for the Profès) were rediscovered and published by Paul Vuillaud; and in 1970, the Instructions secrètes aux Grands Profès (Secret Instructions for the Grands Profès) by Antoine Faivre. But since then, the four components of Papus’s title cited at the beginning, “Martinesism, Willermozism, Martinism, and Freemasonry”, have met with increasing success, which goes to show that to study this question does not imply a merely antiquarian and documentary interest, and that the doctrine of reintegration offers to a number of men of our time a “spiritual goal” as much appreciated by them as it was by Willermoz.
body.zh: 还应补充说，此后一切形态的马丁主义都经历了漫长的隐没。圣马丁的著作在19世纪末由→帕普斯重新发掘之前，一直没有读者；《论重新整合》（Traité de la réintégration）此前只以手稿形式流传，直到1899年才首次刊行；《致誓士的秘密训令》（Instructions secrètes aux Profès）直到1926年才由保罗·维约（Paul Vuillaud）重新发现并刊布；而《致大誓士的秘密训令》（Instructions secrètes aux Grands Profès）则由安托万·费弗尔（Antoine Faivre）于1970年刊布。但自那时以来，本文开头所引帕普斯标题中的四个组成部分——“马丁内斯主义、维勒莫兹主义、马丁主义与共济会”——日益获得成功，这表明研究这一问题并非只具有古物学与文献学的兴趣，也表明重新整合的教义为当代的许多人提供了一个“灵性目标”，他们对此的珍视不亚于当年的维勒莫兹。
