body.text: Among contemporary religious and esoteric phenomena, there are some which seem so closely associated with modern ideas and themes that it might be considered premature to associate them with a word like “tradition”, evocative of something with roots in a relatively long past. The esoteric currents associated with UFOs (Unidentified Flying Objects) represent such a case. The emergence of the “flying saucer” phenomenon is usually associated with Kenneth Arnold’s (1915-1984) sightings in June 1947. However, research done over the past decades has clearly shown that the UFO theme existed already earlier: certain pre1947 books of fiction contain most of the elements subsequently associated with manifestations of extraterrestrial entities, including the physical shape of the spaceships. As has been demonstrated by Bertrand Méheust, a number of novels published between 1880 and 1945 had developed an approach which “technologized magic” and “resacralized technology”, thus creating features from which the UFO myth would extensively borrow. Moreover, and of direct relevance for issues dealt with here, groups of UFO believers did not appear out of the blue, but received much of their inspiration from the occult milieu [→occult/ occultism], with which a number of “contactees” were actually familiar. An adequate overview of UFO beliefs therefore needs to trace their pre1947 roots.
body.zh: 在当代的宗教与秘传诸现象中，有些似乎与现代的观念和主题联系得如此紧密，以至于若把它们与“传统”这样令人联想到某种根植于相对久远之过去的词联系起来，或许会被视为为时过早。与UFO（Unidentified Flying Objects，不明飞行物）相关的秘传思潮正是这样一种情形。“飞碟”现象的出现，通常被追溯到肯尼思·阿诺德（Kenneth Arnold，1915—1984）1947年6月的目击事件。然而，过去数十年的研究已清楚表明，UFO主题在此之前便已存在：某些1947年以前的小说包含了后来与外星实体显现相关联的大部分要素，包括飞船的物理外形。正如贝特朗·梅厄斯特（Bertrand Méheust）所论证的，1880年至1945年间出版的一批小说发展出一种进路，它“使魔法技术化”，并“使技术重新神圣化”，从而创造出UFO神话将大量借用的种种特征。此外——这一点与本文所论问题直接相关——UFO信徒群体并非凭空出现，而是从秘传圈子［→秘传／秘传主义］中获得了大部分灵感，若干“接触者”实际上对这样的圈子颇为熟悉。因此，要恰当地概述UFO信仰，就需要追溯其在1947年以前的根源。

body.text: The prehistory of the UFO traditions probably begins around the 18th century, and as observed by Gordon Melton, →Emanuel Swedenborg can be considered an appropriate point of departure. Some of Swedenborg’s theological treatises have occasionally been a source of embarrassment even for the Swedish seer’s most fervent admirers, and De Telluribus in Mundo nostro Solari (Earth in the Universe) is an obvious case. Did not Swedenborg claim to have spoken with spirits of the Moon and of other planets? Most of the content of this treatise can actually be found in Swedenborg’s Arcana Caelestia, but the fact that Swedenborg also published it as a separate volume indicates that he attributed some particular importance to it. And in this he was not alone: Earths in the Universe was actually the first of his books translated and published into German (by →Friedrich Christoph Oetinger, 1770), and four German editions appeared during Swedenborg’s lifetime. It was also one of the first volumes translated into French (by →Pernety in 1782). If the treatise has embarrassed late 20th century Swedenborgians, during the 18th century it was seen, on the contrary, as a rather attractive approach to solving the riddle of the plurality of the worlds. Swedenborg was not alone in his speculations about inhabitants of other worlds: his famous critic, Immanuel Kant (1724-1804), not only seriously considered the hypothesis that there could be human beings on other planets, but even the possibility that they might be places of residence for people from Earth in future incarnations after their present life.
body.zh: UFO传统的史前史或许始于18世纪前后；正如戈登·梅尔顿（Gordon Melton）所观察到的，→伊曼纽尔·斯威登堡（Emanuel Swedenborg）可被视为一个恰当的起点。斯威登堡的某些神学论著有时甚至令这位瑞典灵视者最热忱的仰慕者也感到难堪，《论我们太阳系世界中的诸地球》（De Telluribus in Mundo nostro Solari，英译Earth in the Universe）便是一个明显的例子。斯威登堡不正是声称自己曾与月球及其他行星的精灵交谈过吗？这篇论著的大部分内容其实都可以在斯威登堡的《属天的奥秘》（Arcana Caelestia）中找到，但他又将其作为单行本出版，这一事实表明他对之赋予了某种特别的重要性。在这一点上他并非孤例：《宇宙中的诸地球》实际上是他第一部被译成德文并出版的著作（由→弗里德里希·克里斯托夫·厄廷格［Friedrich Christoph Oetinger］于1770年译出），在斯威登堡生前共有四个德文版本问世。它也是最早被译成法文的著作之一（由→佩尔内蒂［Pernety］于1782年译出）。如果说这篇论著曾令20世纪晚期的斯威登堡追随者感到难堪，那么在18世纪，它反倒被视为解决诸世界多重性（the plurality of the worlds）之谜的一条颇具吸引力的途径。斯威登堡关于其他世界居民的思辨并非孤例：他著名的批评者伊曼纽尔·康德（Immanuel Kant，1724—1804）不仅认真考虑过其他行星上可能存在人类的假设，甚至考虑过这样的可能性：在来自地球的人于今生之后的未来化身中，这些行星或可成为他们的居所。

body.text: However, Swedenborg was not the first “contactee”: while his reports do not belong to the category of literary utopias or fantastic voyage novels, neither did he claim to have travelled to other planets in his physical body aboard some spaceship or to have spoken with extraterrestrial entities descended to Earth for bringing some message. Rather, he claimed to have spoken with spirits and angels who lived on those other planets, having been transported there in the spirit while his body remained on our Earth. Still, his style of writing is not unlike contemporary travel reports, in which an explorer depicts exotic civilizations. The extraterrestrials turn out to have human forms, even if they may have some peculiar features: for instance, the residents of Venus are giants. Interestingly, Swedenborg explains that there are also inhabited planets outside our solar system, and claims to have met some of their representatives as well. In any case, none of these extraterrestrials are presented as messengers of a new religious doctrine: Swedenborg’s universe is Christocentric, and Ernst Benz has even suggested that Swedenborg was a pioneer in the elaboration of a cosmic Christology.
body.zh: 然而，斯威登堡并非第一位“接触者”：他的记述虽然不属于文学乌托邦或奇幻航行小说之类，但他也未曾声称自己乘坐某种飞船以肉身前往其他行星，或与降临地球传递某种讯息的外星实体交谈。相反，他声称自己与之交谈的，是居住在那其他行星上的精灵与天使；他是以灵的形式被带往彼处，而肉身仍留在地球上。不过，他的写作风格与当时的旅行报告并无二致——在那些报告中，探险者描绘异域文明。这些外星人结果都具有人形，尽管他们可能带有某些奇特特征：例如，金星居民是巨人。有趣的是，斯威登堡解释说，在我们太阳系之外也存在有居民的行星，并声称自己也见过其中一些行星的代表。无论如何，这些外星人中没有一个被呈现为新宗教教义的使者：斯威登堡的宇宙是以基督为中心的，恩斯特·本茨（Ernst Benz）甚至提出，斯威登堡是建构一种宇宙基督论（cosmic Christology）的先驱。

body.text: Several other philosophers commented on the plurality of the worlds in their works. Among the recipients of new revelations, →Lorber received dictations about the Moon, Saturn and their inhabitants, which are still read with interest by some UFO believers today, especially in German-speaking countries. But most important for the emergence of the UFO tradition was the current of 19th century →Spiritualism. If one reads the Revue spirite published in Paris from 1858, it is easy to discover, from its very first year of publication, articles mentioning the plurality of worlds. It dealt with such topics because communications received by several mediums confirmed the existence of living beings on other planets; the acknowledgement of the plurality of inhabitated worlds was therefore widespread in Spiritualism from its very first years. Spiritualism offered the possibility to get in touch with other planets without needing a spaceship. As with Swedenborg, there is definitely a fascination with the exotic: undoubtedly it is not just by chance that the medium Elise Müller, alias Hélène Smith (1861-1929) – who was closely examined in Geneva at the end of the 19th century by the renowned psychologist Théodore Flournoy (1854- 1920) and described in his book Des Indes à la planète Mars (1900) – reported about civilization on Mars in one series of communications, and had India as the background of another series; the popularity of spirits of American Indians among some mediums is a well-known phenomenon as well.
body.zh: 另有一些哲学家在其著作中论及诸世界的多重性。在新启示的接受者当中，→洛贝尔（Lorber）接收了关于月球、土星及其居民的听写记录，这些记录至今仍被某些UFO信徒饶有兴趣地阅读，尤其是在德语国家。但对UFO传统的兴起而言，最重要的乃是19世纪的→唯灵论（Spiritualism）思潮。只要阅读自1858年起在巴黎出版的《灵学评论》（Revue spirite），便不难发现，从它创刊的第一年起，就有文章提及诸世界的多重性。它之所以讨论这类主题，是因为若干通灵者所接收的通信证实了其他行星上存在有生命的存在者；因此，对诸世界有居民这一点的承认，从唯灵论最初几年起便已十分普遍。唯灵论提供了无需飞船便可与其他行星取得联系的可能性。与斯威登堡一样，其中无疑存在着对异域事物的迷恋：19世纪末在日内瓦受到著名心理学家泰奥多尔·弗卢努瓦（Théodore Flournoy，1854—1920）仔细考察、并在其《从印度到火星》（Des Indes à la planète Mars，1900）一书中得到描述的通灵者埃莉斯·米勒（Elise Müller），又名埃莱娜·史密斯（Hélène Smith，1861—1929），在一系列通信中报告了火星上的文明，而在另一系列通信中则以印度为背景——这无疑并非纯属偶然；美洲印第安人的精灵在某些通灵者中间广受欢迎，这也是一个众所周知的现象。

body.text: Spiritualism thus offered unlimited venues for discovering exotic cultures and exploring unknown territories. But from a doctrinal perspective, there was more at stake. According to the Spiritualist school led by →Allan Kardec (1803-1869), the plurality of worlds and the plurality of existences were closely related: human beings incarnate successively on different planets in accordance with different levels of spiritual evolution. Such views opened grandiose perspectives on an interplanetary brotherhood. And it may be more than a coincidence that the famous French astronomer Camille Flammarion (1842-1925) was also associated with the Spiritualist movement. Even though he eventually admitted that Spiritualism had brought him no new knowledge in the field of astronomy, early in his life he had published a book titled La pluralité des mondes habités (1862), in which he declared his belief that people on other planets in space belong to ‘our immense human family’, and stated that ‘The doctrine of the plurality of the worlds has led us to the gates of a religious belief built upon the real system of the world’. In a later work, Les terres du ciel (1877), however, he speculated that residents of other planets were likely to be completely different from what we are, and possibly had forms we were not even able to imagine.
body.zh: 唯灵论由此为发现异域文化、探索未知疆域提供了无限的场所。但从教义层面看，其中牵涉的还不止于此。在由→阿兰·卡尔德克（Allan Kardec，1803—1869）领导的唯灵论学派看来，诸世界的多重性与存在的多重性密切相关：人依灵性进化程度的不同，相继在不同的行星上化身。这类观点开启了关于一种星际兄弟情谊的宏大远景。法国著名天文学家卡米耶·弗拉马里翁（Camille Flammarion，1842—1925）也与唯灵论运动有所关联——这或许并非只是巧合。尽管他最终承认唯灵论并未在天文学领域带给他任何新知识，但他在早年曾出版《有人居住的诸世界的多重性》（La pluralité des mondes habités，1862）一书，其中他宣示了自己的信念：太空中其他行星上的人属于“我们庞大的人类家庭”；他还说：“诸世界多重性的学说已把我们引向一种宗教信念的门前，这一信念建立在世界的真实体系之上。”然而，在后来的著作《天空中的诸地球》（Les terres du ciel，1877）中，他却推测其他行星上的居民很可能与我们完全不同，其形态甚至可能是我们根本无法想象的。

body.text: Spiritualism did not exist in isolation: it frequently tended to interact with other alternative worldviews, as one can see from the list of participants and topics dealt with at Spiritualist international congresses. Thus, the →Theosophical Society obviously could not remain immune from the interest for other worlds. In his book The Inner Life (1910-1911), →Leadbeater described the ‘present conditions of the planet Mars’ as ‘by no means unpleasant’, and not overcrowded; the Martians, he explained, ‘are not unlike ourselves, except that they are considerably smaller’ – once again, we find a perception of extraterrestrials as basically human or humanoid beings. Leadbeater’s work also reads somewhat like the description of an utopia: ‘it is the custom to hand over all the children to the State at a very early age to be reared and educated’, ‘they have absolutely no religion . . ., nothing is true but what can be scientifically demonstrated’. Leadbeater did not claim to have physically traveled to Mars: astral travel could obviously do the same job. Most interesting is his mention of the existence of a secret society on that planet, whose members had developed ‘a good deal of power’: ‘Some at least of the members of the secret society have learnt how to cross without great difficulty the space which separates us from
body.zh: 唯灵论并非孤立存在：它常常倾向于与其他另类世界观互动，这一点从唯灵论国际大会的与会者名单和所讨论的议题中即可看出。因此，→神智学学会（Theosophical Society）显然也无法对其他世界的兴趣置身事外。在《内在生活》（The Inner Life，1910—1911）一书中，→利德比特（Leadbeater）把“火星目前的条件”描述为“绝非令人不快”，而且并不拥挤；他解释说，火星人“与我们并无不同，只是身材要小得多”——我们再次看到一种把外星人视为基本上是人或类人存在的看法。利德比特的著作读起来也颇像对乌托邦的描述：“那里的习俗是，所有儿童在很小的年纪就被交给国家抚养和教育”，“他们完全没有宗教……除了能够以科学方式证明的东西，没有什么是真实的”。利德比特并未声称自己肉身旅行到了火星：星光体旅行显然可以完成同样的任务。最有趣的是，他提到该行星上存在一个秘密社团，其成员已发展出“相当大的力量”：“这个秘密社团中至少有一些成员已学会如何不太费力地穿越那分隔我们与

body.text: Mars, and have therefore at various times tried to manifest themselves through mediums at spiritual seances, or have been able, by the methods which they have learnt, to impress their ideas upon poets and novelists’. Here we have a hint about a possible role of extraterrestrials not just as beings who obligingly reply to inquisitive mediums, but as agents who take deliberate action to deliver selected information to their terrestrial counterparts. Leadbeater’s suggestion that such information could be transmitted through fictional literature as well is worth noticing, since some UFO enthusiasts continue to hold such beliefs even today: for instance, members of the American group Heaven’s Gate (who committed suicide in March 1997) considered popular science fiction entertainment series as valuable sources of information and explained that ‘the context of fiction can often open the mind to advanced possibilities which are, in reality, quite close to fact’.
body.zh: 火星的空间，并因此曾多次试图通过通灵者在降神会上显形，或者凭借他们所学到的方法，把自己的观念印入诗人与小说家的心中。”这里我们得到一点提示：外星人的角色可能不只是有求必应地回应爱探究的通灵者，而且还是会采取有意行动、向地球上的对应者传递特定信息的行动者。利德比特关于这类信息也可通过虚构文学传递的提示值得注意，因为某些UFO热衷者至今仍持有这样的信念：例如，美国团体“天堂之门”（Heaven’s Gate，其成员于1997年3月集体自杀）的成员就把流行的科幻娱乐系列剧视为宝贵的信息来源，并解释说，“虚构的语境往往能开启心灵，使之接受那些先进的、实际上与现实相当接近的可能性”。

body.text: But there was more to the Theosophical Society than Leadbeater’s astral scouting into other worlds. →Blavatsky’s elaborate system could obviously not limit itself to only this Earth: ‘Every celestial body in space, of whatever kind or type, is under the overseeing and directing influence of a Hierarchy of spiritual and quasi-spiritual and astral beings’. Most of the planets inside as well as outside our solar system are inhabitated by human beings. Similar to Kardecist teachings, each planet corresponds to an evolutionary stage in mankind’s progress. Most important of all, Theosophical teachings are said to go back to a visitation of our Earth by “Adepts” from Venus. The careful research conducted by Wiktor Stoczkowski has shown how the ultimate roots of the Ancient Astronaut theory – according to which the origins of mankind and of civilization go back to extraterrestrial intervention – can be found in Blavatsky’s doctrines and cannot be understood without that preexisting occult milieu. As this French anthropologist has correctly observed, this does not mean that advocates of the Ancient Astronaut theory have read Blavatsky’s works in depth: due to the numerous and diverse posterity (legitimate or otherwise) of the Theosophical Society, Theosophical teachings have had such widespread influence that its basic ideas can become familiar even to those who have not been in direct contact with Theosophical literature.
body.zh: 但神智学学会所包含的，不止利德比特对诸世界的星光体侦察。→布拉瓦茨基（Blavatsky）那套精巧的体系显然不可能只局限于这一个地球：“太空中每一个天体，无论其种类或类型如何，都处于一个由灵性的、半灵性的与星光的存在者构成的品级体系的监督与指导性影响之下。”我们太阳系内外的绝大多数行星上都居住着人类。与卡尔德克派的教义相似，每一行星都对应着人类进步过程中的一个进化阶段。最重要的是，据说神智学教义可追溯至来自金星的“阿德普特”（Adepts）对我们地球的一次造访。维克托·斯托奇科夫斯基（Wiktor Stoczkowski）所做的细致研究表明，古代宇航员理论——该理论认为人类与文明的起源可追溯至外星干预——的终极根源可以在布拉瓦茨基的学说中找到，若不理解那个先在的秘传圈子，便无法理解这一理论。正如这位法国人类学家所正确指出的，这并不意味着古代宇航员理论的倡导者曾深入阅读布拉瓦茨基的著作：由于神智学学会有着众多而多样的后裔（无论正统与否），神智学教义的影响如此广泛，以致其基本观念甚至能为那些未曾直接接触神智学文献的人所熟悉。

body.text: Venusian Masters returned to the scene with Guy Warren Ballard (1878-1939) and his →“I AM” Activity. Published in 1934 under the pen name of “Godfré Ray King”, his Unveiled Mysteries culminate in the narrative of an assembly of
body.zh: 金星导师们随着盖伊·沃伦·巴拉德（Guy Warren Ballard，1878—1939）及其→“我是”（“I AM”）活动重新登场。他化名“戈弗雷·雷·金”（“Godfré Ray King”）于1934年出版的《揭开的奥秘》（Unveiled Mysteries），以一段关于集会的叙述达到高潮，那是在

body.text: Masters at a mysterious American retreat, welcoming visitors from Venus ‘robed in white scintillating garments, surpassing all powers of description’: ‘Their brilliant, piercing, violet-blue eyes were beautiful and fascinating’. The Venusians were obviously much more advanced than the people of Earth, for Ballard and his family were allegedly given the opportunity to take a first glimpse at ‘tremendous’ Venusian inventions which ‘will come into use on earth in the Golden Crystal Age we have now entered’. While it may be going somewhat too far, as some scholars have done, to claim that “I AM” was the first religious movement built on contact with extraterrestrials (in fact it was mainly built on contacts with “Masters”, following the pattern of the Theosophical Society, while transforming it), it has definitely some features which would become part of the subsequent UFO religions: the description of attractive, handsome extraterrestrials, with piercing eyes, evoking the idea of divine messengers; the superiority of the extraterrestrial; and their message of relief and salvation for the Earth, which will be able to overcome its predicaments thanks to the extraordinary technological knowledge brought from other worlds.
body.zh: 美国某处神秘隐修地举行的导师集会，会上迎接来自金星的访客，他们“身着闪亮的白色衣袍，非笔墨所能形容”：“他们那双明亮、锐利的紫蓝色眼睛美丽而迷人。”金星人显然远比地球人先进，因为据称巴拉德及其家人获得了机会，得以一窥金星人“惊人的”发明，这些发明“将在地球上我们如今已进入的黄金水晶时代（Golden Crystal Age）投入使用”。尽管如某些学者那样，声称“我是”是第一个建立在与外星人接触之上的宗教运动或许有些过甚（事实上它主要建立在与“导师”的接触之上，沿袭神智学学会的模式并对其加以改造），但它确实具备若干后来成为UFO宗教一部分的特征：对外形迷人、英俊、目光锐利的外星人的描绘，令人联想到神圣使者的观念；外星人的优越性；以及他们为地球带来解脱与救赎的讯息——地球将凭借从其他世界带来的非凡技术知识，克服自身的困境。

body.text: After the 1947 sightings, it did not take long for the first contactees to emerge. While the importance of the occult milieu in relation to this development is emphasized here, it should be clear that there were other dimensions involved as well. When one reads the literature of UFO believers in the late 1940s, it is striking to see how the “things seen in the sky” (→C.G. Jung) are constantly associated with the nuclear threat: the extraterrestrials were manifesting themselves in order to warn mankind of the risk of self-destruction (and possibly to evacuate those deemed worthy to escape, in case annihilation could not be prevented). While equipped with superior technology, the entities from other worlds were seen as much wiser than human beings in their use of it. In any case, there are strong reasons to assume that the UFO myth would not have unfolded the way it did without the horror of Hiroshima at the end of World War II.
body.zh: 1947年的目击事件之后，第一批接触者很快就出现了。尽管此处强调的是秘传圈子对这一发展的重要性，但应当清楚，其中还涉及其他维度。阅读20世纪40年代后期UFO信徒的文献时，令人惊讶的是，“天空中看见的事物”（→C.G. 荣格）总是与核威胁联系在一起：外星人之所以显现，是为了警告人类自我毁灭的风险（并且，倘若无法阻止毁灭，或许还要撤离那些被认为有资格逃离的人）。这些来自其他世界的实体虽然拥有优越的技术，却被视为在使用技术方面远比人类明智。无论如何，我们有充分理由假定：若没有第二次世界大战结束时广岛的恐怖，UFO神话就不会以它实际经历的方式展开。

body.text: Flying Saucers Have Landed was the title of a book published in 1953, in which George Adamski (1891-1965) claimed to have met a being from Venus, in November 1952. Significantly, from the very beginning the Venusian made it clear to Adamski that concern about atomic weapons was the reason for the extraterrestrials to contact earth. The Venusian provenience is worth noticing as well: it remains on the line of the Theosophical inheritance, and actually there are several direct references to Theosophical literature in the first part of the book, written by a co-author. Adamski insisted that one should not make a religious belief out of UFOs; but this did not prevent him from publishing a Science of Life Study Course (1964), based upon teachings supposedly delivered to him by the Venusians. Especially interesting is the fact that Adamski re-used materials he had already published many years before his alleged contact with UFOs: the title of that earlier book had been Wisdom of the Masters of the Far East (1936), connected with Adamski’s launching in the 1930s of a “Royal Order of Tibet”. In his 1964 work, Adamski replaced the words “Royal Order of Tibet” by “Space Brothers”. In the 1930s, he claimed to have lived as a child in Tibetan monasteries and – while preaching an eclectic universalist doctrine very far from anything Tibetan – he had explained to the Los Angeles Times (8 April 1934) that he had ‘learned great truths up there on the roof of the world’. What matters is not the obvious fact that Adamski – who had also published a novel in 1949 called Pioneers of Space: A Trip to the Moon, Mars and Venus – was a fraud, but that he had a previous career in the alternative religious milieu, and how easy it was for him to just continue propagating the same views in a new, extraterrestrial garb.
body.zh: 《飞碟已登陆》（Flying Saucers Have Landed）是1953年出版的一本书的书名，乔治·亚当斯基（George Adamski，1891—1965）在其中声称自己于1952年11月遇见过一位来自金星的存在者。意味深长的是，这位金星人从一开始就向亚当斯基表明，对原子武器的担忧正是外星人接触地球的原因。金星的来源同样值得注意：它延续了神智学的遗产，而且该书由一位合著者所写的第一部分中，实际上有几处直接引用了神智学文献。亚当斯基坚持认为，人们不应当把UFO变成一种宗教信仰；但这并未妨碍他出版《生命科学研习课程》（Science of Life Study Course，1964），其内容依据的是据称由金星人传授给他的教义。尤其有趣的是，亚当斯基重新使用了他在所谓与UFO接触之前许多年便已发表的材料：那本较早著作的书名是《远东导师的智慧》（Wisdom of the Masters of the Far East，1936），与亚当斯基于1930年代创立“西藏皇家教团”（Royal Order of Tibet）有关。在1964年的著作中，亚当斯基把“西藏皇家教团”一词换成了“太空兄弟”（Space Brothers）。1930年代，他声称自己童年时曾生活在西藏的寺院中，并且——一面宣扬一种与西藏毫无关系的折衷普世主义教义——向《洛杉矶时报》（Los Angeles Times，1934年4月8日）解释说，他“曾在那世界屋脊之上学到伟大的真理”。要紧的并不是亚当斯基——他还在1949年出版了一部名为《太空先驱：月球、火星与金星之旅》（Pioneers of Space: A Trip to the Moon, Mars and Venus）的小说——是个骗子这一显而易见的事实，而是他此前在另类宗教圈子里已有过一番事业，以及他何等轻易地便能改换一身新的、外星的外衣，继续传播同样的观点。

body.text: Not all contactees claimed to have physically met extraterrestrials. George W. Van Tassel (1910- 1978), one of the early contactees, originally claimed to have been in psychic contact with beings from other worlds since 1952. It was only at a later point, in 1953, that he reportedly was allowed to enter a flying saucer. Since mediums had already been transmitting information about life on other planets long before the popular wave of flying saucers began, it is not surprising that some mediums now began to channel messages from extraterrestrials; in fact, such messages became increasingly common during the 1950s. As Ellwood and several other scholars have observed, religious belief in UFOs and Spiritualism are of the same type: ‘Both presuppose an order of spiritually significant beings between the human and ultimate reality, with which one can have conversational and disciplic relationships. . . . interaction with them opens up a sense of expanded consciousness and cosmic wonder. . . . In both there are physical phenomena or “traces” which serve to support belief, but which for real believers are like “signs” in a religious sense . . .’. This does not mean that all mediums began enthusiastically to received communications from extraterrestrials: it has been observed that the ‘adoption of extraterrestrials as spirit guides is much more prevalent among →New
body.zh: 并非所有接触者都声称曾在肉体上遇见外星人。早期接触者之一乔治·W. 范塔塞尔（George W. Van Tassel，1910—1978）最初声称，自1952年起便与其他世界的存在者保持着灵媒接触。直到后来，1953年，据说他才获准进入一艘飞碟。由于早在飞碟热潮兴起之前，通灵者便已在传递关于其他行星生命的信息，因此某些通灵者如今开始通传外星人的讯息，并不令人意外；事实上，这类讯息在1950年代变得越来越常见。正如埃尔伍德（Ellwood）及其他几位学者所观察到的，对UFO的宗教信仰与唯灵论属于同一类型：“二者都预设，在人与终极实在之间存在着一个由具有灵性意义的存在者构成的秩序，人可与它们建立对话与师徒式的关系……与它们的互动会开启一种意识扩展和宇宙惊奇之感……二者之中都有物理现象或‘痕迹’作为信仰的支撑，但对真正的信徒而言，这些就像宗教意义上的‘征兆’……”这并不意味着所有通灵者都开始热情地接收来自外星人的通信：有人观察到，“把外星人奉为灵导的做法，在→新纪元

body.text: Age channelers than among traditional Spiritualists’ (Porter).
body.zh: 通灵者中远比在传统唯灵论者中更为普遍”（Porter）。

body.text: As could be expected, contactees – psychic or otherwise – incorporated a number of previouslyheld beliefs. Extraterrestrial contact became one more step in an occult career. A well-known case is the group led by Dorothy Martin, alias Sister Thedra († 1992): not very large or influential in itself, it was the subject of a famous book by three American sociologists, When Prophecy Fails (1956). Martin had been acquainted with occult teachings as early as in the 1930s, became involved in Dianetics [→Scientology], and was fascinated by the teachings of “I AM”, before she herself began to receive messages from Sananda (Jesus in an earlier incarnation), now a resident of the planet Clarion. In the typical style of UFOs’ warnings about impending disasters, in August 1954 she received a message informing the world that cataclysmic changes would soon change the face of America and other continents, while the lost continent of Mu would rise again before the end of that same year. The failure of this prophecy did not prevent her from continuing her activities for the rest of her life, and founding the “Association of Sananda and Sanat Kumara” in 1965.
body.zh: 正如可以预料的，接触者——无论是否具有灵媒能力——都吸纳了若干此前已有的信仰。与外星人的接触成为秘传生涯中的又一个阶段。一个著名的例子是多萝西·马丁（Dorothy Martin），又名西奥德拉修女（Sister Thedra，†1992）所领导的团体：该团体本身规模不大，影响也有限，却成为三位美国社会学家一部名著《当预言失败之时》（When Prophecy Fails，1956）的主题。马丁早在1930年代便已熟悉秘传教义，后来参与戴尼提（Dianetics）［→山达基］，并曾着迷于“我是”的教义，随后她本人开始接收来自萨南达（Sananda，即耶稣在较早一次化身中的身份，现居克拉里昂行星［Clarion］）的讯息。1954年8月，她以一种典型的UFO灾难预警风格收到一则讯息，告知世人：灾难性的变化不久将改变美国及其他各大陆的面貌，而失落的大陆穆（Mu）将在同年年底之前重新升起。这一预言的失败并未阻止她在余生继续其活动，并于1965年创立“萨南达与萨南特·库马拉协会”（Association of Sananda and Sanat Kumara）。

body.text: Another good example of interaction between UFO belief and the occult milieu was George King (1919-1997), founder of the Aetherius Society (referring to the name of a Venusian Master). He came ‘from a family imbued with occult inclinations’ (his mother was a psychic and clairvoyant) and had himself developed a keen interest in the occult and yoga, before he was contacted in 1954 by a Cosmic Master and was called to become the “Voice of the Interplanetary Parliament”. King refered to the Great White Brotherhood, to Adepts and to a whole range of terms typical of the Theosophical current – while mixing them in a quite eclectic way with elements taken from a number of other systems with which he was familiar. Among UFO religious groups, the Aetherius Society represents one of the most obvious derivations from Theosophy – Theosophical Adepts being transformed into “Cosmic Masters” or “Gods from Space”. In some cases, like Ashtar (see below), the multiplication of newly-revealed entities leads to the creation of a ‘pantheon consist[ing] of a wide range of gods, goddesses, and spiritual masters from various planets’, Ashtar and Sananda siding together with “Lady Athena” as a kind of new Trinity (Wojcik). This is not unlike Ballard’s “I AM”, with its many Masters. Ellwood has suggested that UFO beliefs could also be seen as a reinvention of polytheism.
body.zh: UFO信仰与秘传圈子互动的另一个良好例子，是乔治·金（George King，1919—1997），他是埃特里乌斯学会（Aetherius Society，其名取自一位金星导师）的创始人。他“出身于一个充满秘传倾向的家庭”（其母是一位灵媒和千里眼），本人也对秘传与瑜伽产生了浓厚兴趣，随后于1954年受到一位宇宙导师的接触，被召唤成为“星际议会之声”（Voice of the Interplanetary Parliament）。金提到大白兄弟会（Great White Brotherhood）、阿德普特，以及一整系列神智学思潮特有的术语——同时以相当折衷的方式，把它们与取自他所熟悉的若干其他体系的要素混合在一起。在UFO宗教团体中，埃特里乌斯学会代表着最明显的神智学衍生物之一——神智学的阿德普特被转化为“宇宙导师”或“来自太空的诸神”。在某些情形中，如阿什塔尔（Ashtar，见下文），新启示出的实体的增殖导致了一个“由来自各行星的众多男神、女神与灵性导师组成的”万神殿的创立，阿什塔尔与萨南达同“雅典娜夫人”（Lady Athena）并列，构成某种新的三位一体（Wojcik）。这与巴拉德那个拥有众多导师的“我是”并无二致。埃尔伍德曾提出，UFO信仰也可被视为多神教的一种重新发明。

body.text: Although the connections should by now be clear enough, UFO religious groups have often developed into more than just a variation on general occult teachings. Rather, they have amalgamated some elements from esoteric traditions with other beliefs, very often including a millenarian message, since, as we have already seen, extraterrestrials do not just come in order to share some inspired wisdom, but also to preserve humanity from impending threats. Thus they could be described as modern religions of salvation. A good example are the mediums and groups claiming to receive messages from Ashtar, Commander of a fleet of spaceships sent by the Galactic Federation in order to rescue Earth. With a number of these mediums – not necessarily connected with each other – Ashtar’s messages have taken a decidedly catastrophic tone: disasters are likely to occur within the near future, but the chosen ones will be rescued. One can see here an obvious influence from premillenial dispensationalist scenarios, according to which a “rapture” will take place in order to spare the elect from having to go through the “Great Tribulation”: Ashtar’s “Evacuation” is a transparent adaptation of the rapture to a UFO based scenario. This shows that UFO beliefs do not necessarily have to build upon themes from esoteric traditions only, but may quite as easily borrow elements from the Christian tradition – or any other one. In Italy, Giorgio Bongiovanni (b. 1963) declares to have received from the Virgin in Fatima the stigmatas of Christ, first on his hands (1989) and later on his forehead (1993); and at the same time he poses as a spiritual successor of the Sicilian contactee Eugenio Siragusa (b. 1919), despite the latter’s disavowal. Certain Christian groups have incorporated UFO themes as well. One example was Father Michel Colin (1905-1974), who claimed to be the Pope, assumed the pontifical name of Clement XV and created a Renovated Catholic Church; he spoke about “interplanetary” beings and told his faithful that the elect would be taken to Planet Mary. Some Danish followers of Adamski felt attracted toward Clement XV.
body.zh: 尽管这些联系到此应当已经足够清楚，UFO宗教团体往往已发展成不止是对一般秘传教义的一种变体。它们毋宁是把秘传传统中的某些要素与其他信仰融合起来，且往往包含一种千禧年讯息，因为正如我们已看到的，外星人前来并不只是为了分享某种受启示的智慧，也是为了拯救人类免于迫在眉睫的威胁。因此，它们可被描述为现代的救赎宗教。一个良好的例子是那些声称接收阿什塔尔讯息的通灵者与团体；阿什塔尔是银河联邦（Galactic Federation）为救援地球而派出的飞船舰队的指挥官。在若干这类彼此未必相关的通灵者那里，阿什塔尔的讯息带有一种断然的灾难论调：灾难很可能在不久的将来发生，但被拣选者将获救。此处可以看到前千禧年时代论式（premillenial dispensationalist）图景的明显影响：按照这种图景，将发生一次“被提”（rapture），以使选民免于经历“大灾难”（Great Tribulation）；阿什塔尔的“撤离”（Evacuation）正是把被提改编为UFO情景的一种直白做法。这表明，UFO信仰未必只建立在秘传传统的主题之上，也可以同样轻易地从基督教传统——或任何其他传统——借用要素。在意大利，乔治·邦焦万尼（Giorgio Bongiovanni，生于1963年）宣称从法蒂玛的圣母那里领受了基督的圣痕，最初在双手上（1989年），后来在额头上（1993年）；与此同时，他自居为西西里接触者欧金尼奥·西拉古萨（Eugenio Siragusa，生于1919年）的精神继承者，尽管后者对此予以否认。某些基督教团体也吸纳了UFO主题。一个例子是米歇尔·科兰神父（Father Michel Colin，1905—1974），他自称是教皇，采用“克雷芒十五世”（Clement XV）的教宗名号，并创立了一个“革新天主教会”（Renovated Catholic Church）；他谈到“星际”存在者，并告诉信众，被拣选者将被带往“玛利亚行星”（Planet Mary）。一些亚当斯基的丹麦追随者曾对克雷芒十五世心生向往。

body.text: Groups of believers in UFOs will frequently borrow from esoteric themes and sometimes be completely immersed in the occult milieu, but they do not necessarily have to. For instance, the Raelian Movement – at this moment the largest UFO group worldwide, most other UFO groups having remained quite small – holds a materialistic worldview and has little to do with esotericism in any form. The founders of Heaven’s Gate had been familiar with Spiritualist and Theosophical doctrines, but they finally construed a doctrine which to a large extent drew its inspiration from Christian mythology (admittedly with major revisions). UFOs seen as celestial saviors can adjust to a variety of theological backgrounds and develop into new religious beliefs: due to the classical association between the sky and transcendence, the sheer fact that UFOs are seen in the sky can easily endow them with religious connotations. UFOs come from heaven, extraterrestrials seem omniscient, they are close to perfection or at least much more advanced than people of the Earth, they offer salvation from man-made disasters threatening to destroy our planet: as observed by Ted Peters, these are covert religious structures which can easily become a vehicle for a modern religious mythology. In this manner, Extraterrestrials are transformed into the angels of a technological and scientific era. Due to aspirations found in some occultist trends since the 19th century and to a pre-existing interest for extraterrestrial life, it is therefore not surprising that modern esotericism has sometimes become associated with an emergent UFO mythology.
body.zh: UFO信徒群体常常借用秘传主题，有时完全沉浸于秘传圈子之中，但它们未必非得如此。例如，雷尔运动（Raelian Movement）——它目前是全世界最大的UFO团体，其他大多数UFO团体则仍规模甚小——持一种唯物主义的世界观，与任何形式的秘传主义都鲜有关联。“天堂之门”的创立者们曾熟悉唯灵论与神智学教义，但他们最终建构的教义在很大程度上从基督教神话中汲取灵感（诚然经过了重大修改）。被视为天上救主的UFO能够适应各种神学背景，并发展成新的宗教信仰：由于天空与超越性之间自古以来的关联，UFO出现在天空这一单纯事实，便可轻易赋予它们宗教意涵。UFO来自天上，外星人似乎无所不知，他们接近完美，或至少远比地球人先进，他们提供救赎，使人免于威胁毁灭我们这颗行星的人为灾难：正如特德·彼得斯（Ted Peters）所观察到的，这些都是隐性的宗教结构，很容易成为现代宗教神话的载体。以这种方式，外星人被转化为一个技术与科学时代的天使。由于19世纪以来某些秘传主义思潮中的渴望，以及先前便已存在的对外星生命的兴趣，现代秘传主义有时与一种新兴的UFO神话联系在一起，也就不足为奇了。
